jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Lifehouse is looking for an organized, people-focused Program Coordinator to support our Director of Programs and Operations, Marin Supported Living Services (SLS) team, and Quality Assurance team. This is a varied role that combines program coordination, intake, documentation, quality assurance, and office support.

What you will do:

* Support the intake process, including gathering information, conducting interviews with individuals and families, and preparing assessments
* Provide administrative and program support to the Director of Programs and Operations and Marin Supported Living Services team
* Maintain Individual Service Plan (ISP) records, program databases, tracking systems, and other required documentation
* Coordinate and track required program documentation and follow up with staff to ensure records are complete and timely
* Support Quality Assurance activities, training records, and audit preparation
* Coordinate meetings, communications, events, and program materials

What you will bring:

* Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent attention to detail and follow-through
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently
* Professional, collaborative, and people-focused approach
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Adobe
* At least two years of experience in program coordination, administrative support, human services, social services, or a related field
* Experience with interviews, assessments, or reports is a plus
* Bachelor’s degree preferred; nonprofit or human services experience a plus
* Valid California driver’s license, reliable vehicle, and ability to travel locally

Why you would want to join us:

* Competitive Pay: Up to $36.00 per hour
* Make a difference supporting people with developmental disabilities
* Enjoy variety with a role that touches programs, intake, Quality Assurance, and office operations
* Be part of a supportive team in a collaborative, mission-driven organization
* Build your skills across program coordination and nonprofit operations
* Compensation and Benefits
* Full-time, in-person role
* Competitive pay based on experience
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with matching
* Paid time off
* Life and disability insurance
* Employee assistance program

What are you waiting for? Apply today! Join us today and make a difference!

Lifehouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Employee Engagement Program Manager
jobs.description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.

* Note: This position requires presence in our San Francisco/San Jose/Bellevue office location 4 days per week; Lambda’s designated work from home day is currently Tuesday.

We’ve built a lot of great resources for employees: onboarding guides, benefits pages, manager how-tos, and hiring FAQs. But we move faster than we document and maintain. We’re growing quickly. Things get out of date, hard to find, or inconsistent in tone. We need someone to own that problem end to end and make sure every piece of employee-facing content is accurate, easy to find, and sounds like it came from the same team.

This isn’t a pure technical writing role, and it isn’t a traditional program management role either. It’s both. You’ll write, design, and edit, but you’ll also audit, organize, and measure. If you like bringing order to scattered information and quietly making everyone’s job a little easier (maybe even delightful), this is your gig.

**What You’ll Do**

* Audit employee-facing pages, websites, FAQs, guides, and policies.
* Write and edit onboarding guides, templates, FAQs, and how-tos.
* Set consistent tone, voice, and format across content.
* Organize content so employees can find answers.
* Fix pages and processes when something isn't working.
* Track usage and feedback to see what’s working and what isn’t.
* Coordinate with HR, Talent, on shared content.

**What You’ll Bring**

* 3 to 5 years in writing, content, or program coordination.
* Strong, clear, creative writing and editing skills.
* Comfort building style guides and content standards.
* A sharp eye for content that’s outdated or hard to find.
* Comfort tracking metrics like page views, clicks, comments, reactions.
* Nice to have: experience with Notion, Confluence, Wikis.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

You’ll have a front-row seat to the growth of a company shaping the future of tech, and you’ll have a direct hand in making that growth possible. We value speed, tenacity, creativity, and being excellent to each other. You’ll be a part of the Employee Engagement team. Our goal is simple: to be the most helpful team at Lambda. If you want a seat where you can make a huge impact every day and turn chaos into clarity, this is it.

**Salary Range Information**

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

**About Lambda**

* Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast
* Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove
* We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG
* Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers
* We offer generous cash & equity compensation
* Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents
* Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles
* 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)
* Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Lambda is an Equal Opportunity employer. Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.

Compensation Range: $135K - $180K

jobs.title: EDA Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

**Keysight**is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more **about what we do.**

Our**award-winning** culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Keysight is a leading provider of Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software used by communications and semiconductor manufacturers, chip designers, and R&D organizations around the world. Our portfolio, including ADS, RFPro, SystemVue, IC-CAP, and other advanced solutions, helps engineers model, simulate, and optimize increasingly complex electronic designs. Keysight’s EDA experts work alongside customers to solve demanding technical challenges, accelerate innovation, and bring breakthrough technologies to market with greater confidence.

As an **EDA Customer Success Manager**, you will serve as the technical and strategic partner for a select portfolio of Keysight’s largest enterprise customers. You will develop a deep understanding of each customer’s design environment, technical priorities, and business objectives, then lead a coordinated customer-success strategy that expands adoption and makes Keysight solutions an integral part of their design workflows.

You will own the technical customer relationship across engineering teams and senior technical leaders, working closely with account managers, solutions engineers, services, support, and product experts. You will lead technical review meetings, adoption programs, customer training, design-flow initiatives, evaluations, and new-product introductions. You will also help customers overcome technical barriers while bringing their requirements, product feedback, and emerging needs back into Keysight.

Success in this role means helping customers realize measurable value from their Keysight investment through stronger design workflows, increased software usage, successful adoption of new capabilities, and lasting technical partnerships that support retention and expansion.

This is an opportunity for an accomplished EDA professional who wants to combine deep technical expertise with customer leadership, business insight, and program ownership. You will do more than support software: you will help influence how leading engineering organizations solve complex design challenges while shaping the future of Keysight’s software strategy.

  
Responsibilities:

* Develop and lead technical customer-success plans that align Keysight’s EDA solutions with each customer’s design workflows, engineering priorities, and business objectives.
* Build trusted relationships with engineers, senior technical leaders, and executive stakeholders across strategic enterprise accounts.
* Drive software adoption through a regular cadence of technical training, lunch-and-learns, office hours, workshops, and other customer-engagement programs.
* Increase license utilization by helping customers fully use their base subscription capacity and, where appropriate, expand their use of available peak or extension license pools.
* Make Keysight solutions an integral part of customers’ approved design flows by identifying technical gaps, overcoming resistance to change, and guiding the adoption of new tools, workflows, and capabilities.
* Maintain deep knowledge of Keysight’s EDA portfolio and provide credible technical guidance during customer discussions, product evaluations, benchmarks, and complex design engagements.
* Develop a thorough understanding of each customer’s design environment, including its workflows, technical challenges, software usage, organizational priorities, and opportunities for broader adoption.
* Stay actively engaged in customers’ ongoing design and technical activities, including holding on-site or virtual office hours to help engineering teams address design issues.
* Lead Technical Review Meetings (TRMs) and communicate customer progress, risks, requirements, and opportunities to customer stakeholders and internal Keysight teams.
* Coordinate solutions engineers, services, support, product specialists, and other subject-matter experts to address customer needs, prioritize work, and ensure commitments are completed.
* Serve as the voice of the customer to the Keysight Factory, communicating software defects, product requirements, and enhancement opportunities to Keysight’s product and development organizations and helping drive them toward resolution.
* Promote new products, features, and New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives through customer events, technical demonstrations, evaluations, and design-flow engagements.
* Advance key Keysight technology initiatives, including 5G, RF and Microwave (RFMW), High-Speed Digital (HSD), photonics, and other emerging design technologies, by connecting new capabilities to relevant customer challenges and workflows.
* Identify and develop opportunities for design-flow wins, additional license adoption, services engagements, and broader deployment of Keysight solutions across customer teams and locations.
* Partner with account managers and technical teams to develop account plans, customer strategies, and coordinated coverage that support adoption, retention, and account growth.
* Measure and communicate customer outcomes, including proof of value, software adoption, usage growth, design-flow wins, customer health, retention, and expansion.

Qualifications:

*Basic Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent university education in Electrical Engineering or a closely related technica

jobs.title: Resident Care Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The **LVN** **Resident Care Manager** directs, coordinates, and supervises care services provided by care associates for the residents within the Assisted Living Department. Responsible for ensuring exemplary service is delivered with integrity, dignity, and compassion. May be responsible for medication control and coordination with physicians to ensure care and medications are delivered as directed. Responsible for the delivery of high-quality care by encouraging independence and ensuring each resident’s physical, social, cultural, psychosocial and intellectual well- being.

**Schedule: Full time Tues-Sat**

**Pay: $80,000-$90,000**

**What will I do everyday?**

* Responsible for monitoring and evaluating assigned residents and regularly assess levels of care, whenever there is a change in condition and/or to determine whether a resident is no longer appropriate for the setting, notifying Assistant Living Director as required
* Assist residents with simple requests as needed or find appropriate associate to assist
* Learns and understands resident preferences for opportunities to provide exemplary customer service, exceed resident expectations and enhance resident satisfaction
* Responsible for effectively supervising departmental operations as directed on a day-to-day basis under the guidance of the department director or Executive Director
* Responds in a tactful and timely manner to all residents, family members and/or staff
* May be responsible for supervising resident medication programs
* May be asked to monitor all physician orders and ensures they have been followed timely and accurately
* Familiar with medical terminology necessary in the delivery of care services to residents
* Interfaces with physicians, care providers, and outside health services pertaining to the resident’s needs (i.e., hospital, outpatient service, home health, therapies, etc.)
* May be responsible for reviewing resident reports and documentation and ensures all care services have been delivered at each shift and notifies Assisted Living Director of any changes in a resident’s condition or needs
* Assess residents utilizing the company’s resident care software system
* Manages or assists with any emergency situations responsibly and calmly until aid arrives
* May be responsible for assisting with scheduling for Care associates or care conferences
* Regularly or on occasion communicates the company vision and strategy to create alignment between daily activities and company strategy
* Manages direct reports schedules and time-cards as necessary
* Review payroll documentation to minimize missed punches, monitor overtime, and manage labor costs
* Works as part of the team within the department and across the community
* Conduct and/or assists with regular staff and daily stand-up meetings
* Plans, prepares, and monitors daily work schedules to meet labor targets
* May be responsible for planning and preparing assignment sheets for Resident Assistants
* Responsible for managing own and team’s resident confidentiality and privacy at all times
* Maintain high standards of personal appearance and grooming, which includes wearing the proper uniform and name tag when working
* Interviews, hires, trains, manages, and retains highly effective associates and create a culture of associate engagement
* Responsible for coaching, mentoring, team-building, performance management, recognition, and professional development of associates
* Identifies and develops top talent for future succession opportunities
* Set example and expectation of open and honest communication with and between all associates
* Take a pro-active approach to look for ways to increase efficiency and potentially reduce costs to support continuous improvement
* Responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance and reports any issues or concerns immediately to Assisted Living Director and Executive Director
* Responsible for team’s adherence to all regulations, laws and Kisco standards, including the Associate Handbook
* Understands supports and assists as needed in the community sales process
* Performs other related duties as required

**What will I need to be successful in this role?**

  

* Previous supervisory experience preferred
* High school graduate required; college course work preferred
* Licensed Vocational Nurse (LVN) or Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) is preferred
* One to three years’ experience working in senior care

**Special Certifications/Requirements I may need?**

  

* Must have or be able to obtain the appropriate State license required by law if required
* CPR Certified preferred
* Basic competency in the use of multiple forms of technology, including Microsoft Office applications, internet-based and custom
* Ability to work a flexible schedule, including weekends and holidays as needed

**What’s in it for me? (Great Question!)**

* Competitive Salary
* A free meal per shift
* Health-care Benefits including Vision & Dental
* Matching 401k
* Paid Time Off
* Rewards and Bonus Opportunities
* Continuous Training and Growth Opportunities

**What do we do?**

We create a great place to live for our residents and a great place to work for our associates. Kisco Senior Living has been a dynamic, award-winning leader in the senior living industry for over 30 years.

**All offers of employment are subject to satisfying our pre-employment process which includes: successfully passing a drug screen, TB test, Background check and Physical Exam (all paid for by us).**

* **Kisco Senior Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Data Operations
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Program Manager to lead AI solutions and product data operations programs that directly support Meta Superintelligence Lab. In this role, you will oversee end-to-end data operations programs spanning AI model training pipelines, data quality initiatives, and annotation workflows — ensuring that product teams have the high-quality data they need to build and scale AI-driven features. You will collaborate closely with researchers, engineers, product, and operations partners to define program strategies, resolve cross-functional dependencies, and translate complex data challenges into actionable, scalable solutions.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Product Data Operations Responsibilities:**

* Manage and deliver product data operations programs that support AI model training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines across multiple product teams
* Partner with research, engineering, and product teams to define data requirements, align on quality standards, and prioritize data collection and annotation efforts for AI solutions
* Identify and resolve bottlenecks in data labeling, annotation, and curation workflows to ensure timely delivery of high-quality training datasets
* Break down complex data operations challenges into manageable components, applying systematic analysis to design and implement scalable solutions aligned with AI product roadmaps
* Develop and maintain program documentation including data governance frameworks, workflow specifications, risk registers, and milestone tracking for AI data initiatives
* Engage team leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to build alignment on program direction, surface risks proactively, and drive decisions that unblock data operations work
* Track and communicate program health metrics — including data throughput, quality rates, and delivery timelines — adapting communication style and format to technical and non-technical audiences
* Leverage AI tools and workflow automation to improve the efficiency and quality of data operations processes, sharing learnings to scale adoption across the team
* Contribute to team-level goal setting by synthesizing insights from data operations performance and translating them into actionable recommendations for AI product teams
* Adapt program plans in response to shifting AI product priorities, regulatory requirements, or data availability constraints, maintaining focus on highest-impact deliverables

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in program management, data operations, or technical operations roles supporting AI, machine learning, or data-driven product development
* or 2+ years of such experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related technical field
* Fundamental understanding of AI/ML model development and the data requirements across the model lifecycle — including training, evaluation, and fine-tuning data needs
* Experience managing cross-functional programs involving data pipelines, data labeling, annotation workflows, or AI training data quality initiatives
* Experience in analyzing operational data and communicating findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders at varying levels of leadership
* Experience identifying process inefficiencies and implementing scalable solutions within data or AI operations environments

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience using AI-powered tools or workflow automation platforms to redesign and accelerate data operations processes, including demonstrated application of responsible and ethical AI practices such as bias mitigation and quality review
* Experience managing vendor or outsourced data annotation and labeling operations at scale
* Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related technical field
* Experience working directly with research or machine learning teams to define data requirements and evaluate the quality of datasets for AI model development
* Familiarity with data governance practices, metadata management, or compliance considerations relevant to AI training data

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

jobs.title: Case Manager II Eddy Street Apartments
jobs.description:
Position: Case Manager II  
Program: Eddy Street Apartments  
Location: Tenderloin, San Francisco  
Reports To: Deputy Director of Housing Support Services  
Status: Non-Exempt, Union  
Schedule: 9am-5pm, M-F  
Wage: $30.44/hour  
  
Community Forward SF is a collection of vital programs that ensures our neighbors experiencing  
homelessness have effective services designed for their unique needs. Whether one needs  
housing, medical shelter, a safe place to recover, or calm in the face of domestic violence – we care  
for those most vulnerable in our community. We are not just one program. We are a network of  
programs designed to work together to meet every stage of need. We focus on the  
hardest-to-reach, most vulnerable people: Women, Medical Crisis, Substance Use Disorder, and  
Older Adults. Our programs meet the needs of people, rather than demanding that people meet  
the needs of our programs.  
JOB SUMMARY:  
Community Forward SF is hiring a Case Manager II. The Case Manager II primarily supports  
women living with HIV who participate in an approximately 18-month transitional housing  
program designed to support stability, health, and transition to permanent housing. The position  
also provides case management and housing stabilization support to permanent supportive  
housing (PSH) residents at Eddy Street Apartments.  
The Case Manager partners with residents to identify strengths, needs, and self-defined goals and  
provides person-centered support to promote health, housing stability, safety, and  
self-determination. Services include case management assessment and service planning,  
therapeutic engagement, housing stabilization and transition support, advocacy, benefits  
assistance, care coordination, systems navigation, information and education, referrals, and  
connection to community-based resources and providers.  
We are looking for an experienced Case Manager with strong behavioral health knowledge,  
excellent engagement and crisis de-escalation skills, and experience supporting adults with  
complex needs. The Case Manager builds collaborative relationships with residents, supports  
resident-identified goals, helps residents navigate housing, health care, behavioral health, benefits,  
and other systems, and recognizes when additional behavioral health, medical, crisis, or other  
specialized support is needed.  
ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:  

* Establish and maintain a primary caseload of women living with HIV participating in the

transitional housing program and provide case management and housing stabilization  
support to PSH residents as assigned.  
  

* Build collaborative, trauma-informed relationships with residents using therapeutic

engagement strategies that support trust, autonomy, self-determination, and progress  
toward resident-identified goals.  

* Conduct intakes and case management assessments to identify resident strengths, needs,

priorities, resources, and self-identified goals, and orient new residents to their housing  
program, program expectations, available services, staff, and community resources.  

* Meet regularly with residents to collaboratively develop, implement, and update Individual

Service Plans (ISPs) based on case management assessment and centered on  
resident-identified goals, strengths, needs, individual timelines, and personal choices.  

* Support transitional housing participants in identifying and working toward goals related

to HIV and other health care, behavioral health, benefits, income, community connection,  
housing readiness, and transition to permanent housing.

treatment by identifying and addressing barriers such as transportation, scheduling,

addressing barriers that may affect successful tenancy and connecting residents with  
appropriate resources and services.

protocols, and engage supervisors, behavioral health providers, mobile crisis services,  
emergency services, or other appropriate resources when additional intervention is

increased behavioral health, substance use, medical, interpersonal violence, or other  
safety concerns; respond within the Case Manager role, communicate concerns through

substance use, medical, and other health care services, including assistance with referrals,  
scheduling, transportation, communication with providers, and other barriers to care.

jobs.title: Office, Events & Executive Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Hellyeah is an applied research company. We build digital workers: AI agents trained on how the best operators work, running critical business functions, starting with marketing.** Our team took its last product from $0 to $10M run rate in 12 months. HF0, Uncork and Matrix Partners back us.

Our SF HQ at 165 Page St is an office, a studio and an event venue. In one week we can host a panel and a DJ night with projection mapping, take partner visits and keep a full team working. You'll run the building, its vendors, our events and the community around them, and you'll work as EA to one of our founders.

Expect to spend around 40% of your time on office and facilities: letting vendors in, testing their fixes, and receiving and installing deliveries. Another 30% goes to events and community, where you run our event series and grow the community that comes out of it. The last 30% is vendor and executive coordination. You track each open item in writing until you close it. You'll do most of this work on site at our SF HQ.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**1. Property management and maintenance (daily)**

* Act as our single point of contact with the landlord and property manager. File maintenance requests through their portal, follow up on walkthroughs and chase each ticket until it closes.
* Be on site when contractors do the work. Show the plumber the problem, test the shower after the fix, check the garage door and confirm the keycards work.
* Follow the escalation rules: send routine requests by email or portal, and save texts to the property manager for emergencies.

**2. Vendors and building systems (daily)**

* Own the building vendors end to end: security and alarm monitoring, fire and smoke detector service, keycard and access control, internet, trash and recycling, plumbing, cleaning and janitorial, laundry, catering and handyman work.
* Get quotes, compare them, book the work, let techs in, check the result and reconcile the invoice.
* Handle light office IT and access yourself. You'll set up and maintain the Wi-Fi gear, manage keycards and the door access system, and take cameras and smart locks from install to working.
* Learn the building systems cold (alarm silence and reset, access readers, cameras and the panel) so you can handle a tripped detector at 9pm.
* Set the weekly cadence for cleaning, laundry, restocking and trash days so the team walks into a ready office each morning.

**3. Purchasing and receiving (several times a week)**

* Run the office purchase list. Confirm items, quantities and deadlines, check what we've already ordered, and place orders across Amazon, Home Depot, Costco, Instacart and local stores.
* Receive packages, chase missed or returned deliveries with the carrier, and handle returns.
* Install mounts, AV, lighting, furniture and signage, or bring in someone who can.

**4. Event operations (weekly, heavy in event weeks)**

* Run event operations for anything from a 30-person dinner to a 500+ RSVP party: catering, licensed bartenders and drink tickets, DJ and AV, furniture, check-in and cleanup.
* Own event safety and compliance. You'll manage haze and smoke rules in a building with an interconnected fire alarm, QR waivers and 21+ ID checks at the door, security staff, roped-off areas, capacity and event insurance.
* Run crowd control and stage management for intense DJ nights: entry flow and capacity counts, the stage and DJ booth perimeter, crowd surges near the front, security staff placement and a tight run-of-show for changeovers.
* Scout and book outside venues when an event outgrows our space. Keep a vendor list with quotes on file so you can plan each event faster and for less money.

**5. Community, offline and online (weekly)**

* Help run our offline community. You'll host a steady series of events and turn first-time guests into regulars, and regulars into core members.
* Track who comes, who comes back and who brings friends. Follow up with the good ones so they return after their first night.
* Move people from our events into our online community (group chats, Discord or Slack, and newsletters), and keep that space active between events.
* After each event, report RSVPs, show rate, new members and repeat attendees.

**6. Facilities and security policy (as needed)**

* Set and enforce building rules for package handling, door access and guests, plus a stopgap plan for the period before cameras and alarms go live.

**7. EA and executive operations for one of our founders (constant)**

* Turn the founder's quick notes and voice memos into tracked tasks with owners and dates.
* Handle day-to-day errands, purchases, scheduling, logistics and vendor calls so the founder can spend their time on the company.
* Write clear vendor and landlord emails in English, run follow-up checks, and flag a risk as soon as you see it.
* Turn recurring problems into checklists, runbooks, vendor rosters and trackers so you solve each problem once.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You have several years running office, facilities, hospitality or venue operations at a startup, hotel, venue or event space, and you've run a building day to day.
* You have a track record of events you ran, with results you can point to. A recurring series counts for more than one-offs.
* You've built an offline community. Across many events, you turned first-time guests into regulars and grew a core group that keeps showing up.
* You've run an online community, moved people into it from in-person events and kept it active.
* You have a network to call on. If we need catering for 80 on Thursday, a deep clean after a party, a laundry service or a fire-alarm tech, you know who to call or how to find them fast.
* You have hands-on crowd control and stage management experience from packed, intense events: DJ nights, club nights or concerts.
* You're comfortable with building systems and event safety: alarms, access control, capacity, bar service and waivers.
* You own a v

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager, AI Solutions and Enablement, Consumer Apps Marketing
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in product operations, marketing technology, technical program management, management consulting, or technical operations.
* Experience using AI-assisted coding tools or low-code platforms to build and deploy working web apps, live dashboards, or workflow automations (e.g., Apps Script, SQL, or Python/JavaScript).
* Experience designing custom AI workflows, reusable prompt/skill libraries, and grounded context layers (e.g., structured Markdown/spreadsheet configs, or SQL/data connections) using LLMs.
* Experience taking internal tools or operational programs from early piloting to deployment and adoption.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with AI-assisted coding (e.g., Antigravity) tools and Google’s AI and cloud stack (Gemini, AI Studio, NotebookLM, Vertex AI, Cloud Run) to create custom skills, web apps, and chained workflows.
* Experience translating operational challenges into product requirement documents (PRDs) and guiding engineering vendors or development teams to ship complex solutions.
* Experience structuring shared knowledge bases, dynamic prompt configs, and user-centered tools.
* Experience leading internal go-to-market, pilot rollouts, and workshops that drive measurable adoption across non-technical teams.
* Knowledge of web technologies (HTML/CSS/JavaScript), SQL (e.g., BigQuery), or APIs to ground tools in data and measure impact.

**About the job**
-----------------

Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems-from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can-changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $148000 - $215000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Partner with marketing teams to diagnose workflow bottlenecks and prioritize where AI tools and agents can deliver the most impact.
* Build and deploy lightweight production web apps, live dashboards, Workspace automations (Apps Script), custom AI skills, and multi-agent workflows using AI-assisted coding tools and Gemini.
* Author product/business requirement documents (PRDs/BRDs) and guide engineering teams to deliver complex, multi-quarter solutions.
* Lead internal AI solutions from early piloting to wide-scale deployment across Marketing through workflow integration, change management, and workshops.
* Manage tool roadmaps, track adoption and efficiency metrics, and coordinate security, privacy, and legal launch reviews.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Fitness Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
Blackhawk Country Club will be the premier full-service club in the East Bay, where members gather as a community and create lifelong connections through exceptional experiences in an incomparably beautiful setting.

As a member of the Blackhawk Country Club team, you play an integral role in advancing our Club’s Vision and Strategic Plan. You will be expected to adhere to our "6B's," which outline the fundamental expectations we have of every employee. Additionally, we rely on you to embody our HAWKS CODE culture, bringing it to life through your language, attitude, and actions.

At Blackhawk Country Club’s Fitness and Wellness Center, hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. The Fitness Operations Supervisor plays a key role in delivering an exceptional member experience by supporting the day-to-day operations of the Fitness and Wellness Center. This position will take ownership of the front desk operation and serve as the primary liaison between members and staff. Key responsibilities include ensuring smooth communication, a welcoming environment, and consistent service excellence. With a focus on safety, cleanliness, and hospitality, this role sets the tone for the club’s service standards and supports the fitness leadership team in maintaining a five-star experience.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
------------------------------------------

The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following daily:

* Serve as a welcoming and professional point of contact for all members, guests, and staff
* Maintain a general knowledge and understanding of member and guest privileges at The Club. Knowledgeable of all club events, operations, and activities. Answers questions regarding the Club. Informs and educates members on the rules, regulations, and policies of the Club.
* Ensure guest, youth and etiquette policies; communicate facility updates, policies, and program information in a clear and friendly manner
* Assist all members and guests through the sign-in process
* Properly records, documents, and enters member activity into the ClubEssentials system which may include charges.
* Lead by example in delivering warm, personalized, and anticipatory service
* Actively engages with members to build relationships, respond to feedback, and promote a positive and inclusive community
* Maintain neat, organized, and presentable front desk, coffee station, water station, retail shop, as well as laundry and janitorial areas
* Make coffee, lemon/ice water, maintain laundry (wash/dry/fold)
* Sell and promote retail, drinks, snacks, service specials, and programs
* Assist Retail Buyer with tagging, merchandising, receiving inventory as needed
* Maintain the integrity of fitness equipment through detailed cleaning procedures; prevent accidents by keeping equipment organized and in its proper storage
* Routinely check locker rooms, wipe down counters, keep tidy, restock as needed throughout shift
* Order housekeeping and food and beverage supplies, maintain inventory counts
* Conduct Youth Orientations for teen members 14-15 yrs, as well as new member tours
* Assist the Accounting dept. in resolving disputes or making corrections in regard to billing
* Report any member issues/incidents, broken equipment, concerns, etc. to direct supervisor
* Assist with selection for recruiting, hiring, onboarding, coaching, and scheduling new team members

* Contribute suggestions for improvement in partnership with fitness leadership team to offer programs and services to align with member needs/requests and financial objectives
* Partner with the Director on projects such as: member recognition programs, staff incentives, shift duties checklist, and other procedural improvements; creating new and improved systems for efficiencies, and automation
* Aid in the fostering of our culture, bringing the Hawks Code to life
* Partner with the Safety Champion to enhance our culture of safety first
* Partner with fitness leadership team to produce marketing content and materials, communicate member feedback, and work in partnership with group fitness program, personal training, wellness and retail to promote overall success
* Cover front desk attendant shifts as needed, including early morning, evenings, and weekends

**Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* 2+ years in a hospitality, customer service, or retail role preferred.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a warm, service-minded approach
* Strong passion for cleanliness, safety and hospitality excellence
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with a flexible, team-first mindset
* Familiarity with fitness equipment and point of sale software is a plus
* Attention to detail, highly organized, artistic/creative, eye for interior design, and retail experience are ideal
* CPR/AED certification, will train

**Physical Demands and Work Environment:**
------------------------------------------

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the functions.

* **Mobility**: The role may require frequent movement, including, walking, standing, bending, kneeling, or reaching to clean and wipe down equipment, counters, fold towels, move laundry bins, pick up and move equipment.

* **Lifting**: Occasional lifting of supplies, equipment, or inventory items may be necessary unto 50 lbs.
* **Manual Dexterity**: Ability to use hands and fingers for tasks such as typing, writing, operating computer systems, handling paperwork, and managing inventory.
* **Vision**: Clear vision and ability to read written documents, computer screens, and equipment displays are essen

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Title:**
==========

Operations Manager

**Job Description:**
====================

**Job Overview**

The Operations Manager will be responsible for directing company programs and implementing company policy to ensure total compliance with contract duties between company and customer.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

To perform this job successfully and safely, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.

* Plans and develops work schedules to ensure adequate service.
* Prepares schedules for service personnel, assigns personnel to routes.
* Inspects and evaluates physical condition of establishment for program compliance, i.e. safety, quality, and service.
* Conduct quality audits to ensure all work has been completed and quality meets expectations.
* Audits and maintains inventories supplies and equipment.
* Investigates new and promotes improved equipment and methods.
* Reviews customer requests for service to ascertain cause for service request, type of malfunction, and address with manager.
* Implements organization policies and goals.
* Analyzes & facilitates budget requests to identify areas in which reductions can be made.
* Assist in the promotion of services performed to develop new markets, increase share of market, and obtain competitive position in industry.
* Inspects plant and evaluates use of space and facilities.
* Assists with plans, budgets, and schedules modifications including cost estimates bid sheets and contracts.
* Ensures that site meets budget goals on a sustaining basis.
* Assist in the development of long-range plans, conceptual designs, and capital outlay requirements for program/process improvements.
* Coordinates program specifications, requirements for proposals and contracts, and associated documents.
* Compiles data for preparing estimates.
* Maintain and report on financial part of business, such as, labor hours, overhead, supplies, expenses, billing, forecasting and any changes to these areas.
* Maintain a safe work environment for self and employees.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, such as, FLSA, OSHA, ADA, etc.
* Directs supervisory management engaged in support of facilities programs.
* Acts as liaison between company, customers, clients, employees, and subcontractors.
* Maintains contract and contractor status databases.
* Reviews all correspondence concerning contractors and responds as appropriate.
* Establishes and maintains contact with contractors to ensure the smooth working of the contract process.
* Conduct and attend meetings to communicate top down, and bottom up on a consistent real time basis, with customers, clients, and employees.
* Assist with human resource concerns and issues.
* Some travel is required for this position.

**Qualification**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to perform this job safely. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**Education and/ or Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field from a four-year college or university with 2 – 5 years of experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**

May be required to have a valid driver’s license.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

Bilingual a plus

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Customer service, problem solving, time management, project management, planning, excellent communication, presentation, interviewing, coaching and training skills.

Knowledge of Microsoft Office and Computer Skills.

Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.

Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, customers, employees, and public.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

Carries out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, planning, assigning, and directing work; approving and managing time for direct reports; performance evaluations; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems. Ensure employees are properly trained on tasks and safety requirements.

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit and talk or listen. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

Salary: $90K annually.

Position will oversee multiple programs including Pest Control, and events.

  

Schedule is Monday- Friday (8 am to 5 pm) Flexibility preferred.

**Benefits:**
=============

SBM offers comprehensive benefit packages. For information about SBM's benefits, please visit SBM's website at:

www.sbmmanagement.com/careers Careers – SBM

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, sex, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or other legally protected status.***

jobs.title: Real Estate Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Real Estate Operations Manager**

**Plotkowski Deschamps Group | Compass**

**San Francisco, CA | Full-Time, In-Person**

**Salary: $73,000–$90,000 annually**

**About Us**

**The Plotkowski Deschamps Group is an established, high-performing residential real estate team at Compass in San Francisco.**

**Led by Mike Plotkowski and Yulia Deschamps, our team combines extensive San Francisco real estate experience with a commitment to exceptional client service, innovative marketing, and long-term client relationships.**

**We are expanding our team and seeking a highly organized, proactive, and capable Operations Manager to help manage our daily operations and support our continued growth.**

**The Position**

**This is a central role within our business.**

**You’ll work closely with both team leaders, coordinating transactions, listings, marketing, client communications, technology, and administrative operations.**

**We’re looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership, creating systems, solving problems, and making sure important details don’t fall through the cracks.**

**The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple priorities, working independently, and helping a busy real estate team operate efficiently.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Operations & Organization**

* **Manage daily operations and administrative workflows.**
* **Coordinate schedules, meetings, appointments, and team activities.**
* **Track projects, deadlines, and outstanding tasks.**
* **Develop and improve organizational systems and procedures.**
* **Support onboarding and integration of new agents.**

**Real Estate Transactions & Listings**

* **Coordinate listing preparation, photography, staging, marketing, and launch schedules.**

**ABOUT US**  
For over 40 years, 24 Hour Fitness has been a leader in the industry, driven by our mission to help our community live healthier and happier through the transformative power of fitness. With clubs nationwide, we create inclusive, welcoming spaces equipped with premium strength and cardio equipment, studio classes, and innovative digital tools. Our impact goes beyond the gym-we support our members' total well-being through coaching, connection, and community. Join us and be part of a team that's changing lives every day!

**JOB SUMMARY**  
The Operations Manager partners with the General Manager to run a clean, safe, and welcoming club and deliver an exceptional member experience. This role leads the club's front-line operations team, including Club Attendants, Kids' Club Attendants, and Sales & Service Associates, and is accountable for front desk and member service, Kids' Club, club cleanliness, club retail, and day-to-day club administration. Club Attendants report directly to the Operations Manager, who owns club cleanliness standards and results. The Operations Manager drives club performance in retail, invalid usage, and positive member sentiment. The Operations Manager writes and manages team schedules and is the club's owner for wage-and-hour compliance, ensuring every team member receives compliant meal and rest periods and that timecards are accurate, reviewed, and documented. The extent of hands-on involvement in these duties varies with club size, staffing, and business needs.

* Directly supervises Sales & Service Associates, Kids' Club Attendants, and Club Attendants; partners with the General Manager on recruiting, interviewing, and selection.

* Coaches team members in the moment, conducts performance conversations and reviews, and recommends pay, promotion, and corrective action to the General Manager.
* Addresses employee relations concerns promptly and fairly, escalating to the General Manager and Human Resources when appropriate.
* Processes new hire paperwork and personnel changes accurately and on time in the company's HR systems.

* Reviews and approves timecard edits and exceptions with proper documentation, and enforces that all time worked is recorded (no off-the-clock work).
* Ensures compliance with minor work-hour restrictions and work permit requirements, where applicable.
* Monitors labor hours and overtime against budget and reports variances and corrective actions to the General Manager.
* Holds the team accountable to scheduling and timekeeping policies through coaching and documentation, and supports meal and rest audits with the General Manager and Human Resources.

* Leads front desk operations, including member check-in, guest registration, membership inquiries, account updates, and support for digital check-in and the mobile app.
* Resolves member concerns quickly and professionally, escalating to the General Manager when needed.
* May support membership sales activity, including upgrades, add-ons, and Personal Training referrals, and steps in to assist members and team members on sales matters when needed, as business needs require; this role does not own club sales goals.
* Works front desk shifts as needed to support coverage and model service standards.

* Drives club performance in retail, invalid usage, and positive member sentiment; reviews results with the General Manager and leads the team in action planning to improve them.
* Drives club retail and owns daily retail tasks, including merchandising, product presentation, merchandise transfers, inventory receiving and control, and inventory reports, in accordance with company policy.
* Builds positive member sentiment through visible floor presence, regular member engagement and satisfaction surveys under company guidelines, quick issue resolution, and consistent service standards across the team.

**Kids' Club**

* Oversees Kids' Club operations, ensuring child safety, accurate check-in and check-out, appropriate supervision ratios, cleanliness, and compliance with company policy and applicable state requirements.
* Ensures incidents are documented and escalated according to company procedures and that parents and members are communicated with appropriately.

* Trains and develops Kids' Club Attendants on child-safety procedures and supervises child activity and behavior in the room.

--------------------

The Senior Manager, AI, Technology, and Innovation Solutions is a pivotal leadership role within the Center of Excellence (CoE) for Facilities Management & Engineering. Reporting directly to the Global Director of Facilities Management & Engineering, this position is responsible for driving the research, piloting, and implementation of innovative technology solutions—including artificial intelligence (AI), digital twins, advanced analytics, and customer workplace facing applications—to optimize data governance, facilities operations, sustainability, business outcomes, and workplace experience. The Senior Manager will oversee the full lifecycle of technology innovation: from scouting and evaluating emerging solutions, to managing pilots and scaling successful initiatives, to ensuring robust data collection, analysis, governance, and stakeholder reporting. Additionally, the role includes direct management and development of two Technology Analysts, fostering a high-performance team culture aligned with the CoE’s mission of operational excellence and continuous improvement.

This position requires a unique blend of technical expertise in AI and digital technologies, strategic vision, project management acumen, and strong leadership and communication skills. The Senior Manager will serve as a key interface between technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners, ensuring that technology investments are aligned with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a proven track record in leading technological innovation within complex, global environments, particularly in facilities, operations, or related domains.

jobs.title: Talent Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Re:Build**
------------------

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. *(link to* The Re:Build Way principles*)*

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

Re:Build seeks a hands-on Recruiting Operations Manager to architect and build our AI-enabled talent acquisition function. **Your most important qualification is expert-level experience deploying reliable AI workflows that deliver measurable results, not just using AI tools or creating demonstrations.**

We have budget, internal resources, and support from our Digital Innovation Group. Our technology environment includes but does not have to be limited to **Greenhouse ATS, Clay, LinkedIn Recruiter, Textio, and Criteria.**

**What you get to do**
----------------------

* **AI architecture and delivery:** Own the roadmap from workflow design and prototyping through deployment, adoption, and improvement. Determine when to configure, integrate, buy, or build.
* **Conversational AI:** Deploy hiring-team and candidate-facing agents for requisition intake, process guidance, scheduling, and updates, with authorized system actions and human handoffs.
* **Recruiting infrastructure:** Own system configuration, integrations, data quality, documentation, and vendor performance; reduce administrative work and unnecessary tools.
* **Analytics and planning:** Partner with Finance on workforce planning. Track on-time hiring against fill dates set at requisition opening, recruiter capacity, user experience, costs, and AI impact.
* **Team enablement:** Partner with recruiters, hiring leaders, Digital Innovation, and IT to build practical AI capabilities and turn prototypes into adopted, supported workflows.
* **Responsible deployment:** Establish testing, monitoring, access controls, data protection, accessibility, and fairness safeguards, preserving human accountability for hiring decisions.

**What you bring to the Team**
------------------------------

* Personally delivered multiple AI-enabled workflows into sustained use, including recruiting applications, with measurable results.
* Production experience with conversational agents, trusted knowledge sources, connected systems, multi-step tasks, and human escalation.
* Hands-on fluency with APIs, webhooks, structured data, automation platforms, and AI-assisted development; able to build independently and guide technical partners.
* Strong recruiting operations, analytics, and change-management expertise, with the judgment to distinguish technology needs from process or capacity issues.

**Experience that would be especially valuable**
------------------------------------------------

Experience with our tools, manufacturing, engineering, skilled-trades, or multi-business recruiting is valuable. Exact-tool experience does not replace demonstrated AI implementation expertise.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

Less administrative work, better hiring-team and candidate experiences, stronger workforce visibility, and measurable gains in speed, quality, service, and cost, with reliable solutions people use.

**How we will assess your experience**
--------------------------------------

Be prepared to discuss two production deployments: what you personally built, reliability and adoption, measurable impact, and lessons learned. Demonstrated delivery matters more than years using a particular AI product.

jobs.title: Staff Customer Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**

As Staff Customer Operations Manager, you will lead Crusoe's customer feedback ecosystem and use it to shape strategy and operations. You will unify customer and market signals, build a comprehensive view of our customer base, monitor the competitive landscape, and deliver evidence-backed recommendations to executive leadership.

This role connects intelligence to business outcomes. You will track how AI models are evolving and what those shifts mean for GPU demand and our Managed Intelligence offerings, prepare executive customer updates for Cloud Leadership, bring customer evidence into Product and Engineering planning, and build the business case for where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* Design and scale the systems that capture, triage, and route customer feedback, including the taxonomy, quality standards, and a central repository of customer evidence
* Own executive update cadences for Cloud Leadership, including the quarterly Voice of Customer executive briefing and Monthly Business Reviews, tracking wins, customer experience signals, and operational updates across the CX team
* Identify where Crusoe should invest in the customer experience based on customer demand, market analysis, and cost to serve
* Advocate for customers in Product and Engineering planning with evidence-based insights, and track the lifecycle of each request from intake through prioritization, delivery, and adoption
* Build the business case for new service offerings and lead their incubation through launch
* Support go-to-market teams with account reviews, customer-specific analysis, and targeted research
* Maintain a comprehensive view of Crusoe's customers, covering segmentation, adoption, and infrastructure footprint, and flag risks such as churn, along with expansion opportunities and behavioral shifts, to account teams
* Monitor competing GPU cloud and inference platforms, including product releases, pricing, and service commitments
* Track AI models across their lifecycle, from frontier and open-weight releases through fine-tuning, serving, and retirement, and map which models and workloads customers train and serve on Crusoe
* Explain what model shifts, such as new architectures, longer context windows, lower-precision formats, and new inference engines, mean for GPU demand, Managed Inference offerings, and account risk

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* 8+ years in customer operations, Voice of Customer, CX or product strategy, or consulting, translating customer feedback into operational changes
* Technical fluency in AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, or developer tooling, with the ability to read technical documentation, support tickets, and release notes
* Ability to separate true technical differentiation from marketing claims
* Strong executive writing skills for memos, briefs, and recommendations
* Proven ability to influence without direct authority
* Comfortable building operating frameworks and processes in ambiguous environments
* Hands-on experience prototyping and operationalizing workflows with AI tools
* Experience at an AI lab, GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or inference platform
* Background in building competitive intelligence or Voice of Customer programs
* Skill in translating technical insights into a business case

**Benefits:**

* Competitive compensation and equity packages
* Restricted Stock Units
* Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs
* Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance
* Employer contributions to HSA account
* Paid parental leave
* Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability
* Professional development & tuition reimbursement
* Mental health & wellness support
* Commuter benefits (parking & transit)
* Cell phone stipend
* 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary
* Volunteer time off
* Global travel insurance & emergency assistance
* Daily meals allowance
* Additional perks & programs specific to location

**Compensation Range**

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 - $190,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.title: Senior Facilities Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**Position Summary**

The **Senior Facilities Operations Manager** is responsible for the day-to-day facilities' soft services operations across Nextpower’s U.S. offices, ensuring each location is clean, functional, well-supported, and ready for daily business operations.

The role leads site-based office operations personnel and manages the delivery of facilities soft services, including reception and front-of-house operations, janitorial and day porter services, pantry and food services, office supplies, mail and shipping, conference and common-area readiness, waste and recycling, and other day-to-day office services.

This position serves as the primary operational interface between office occupants and the Facilities organization, ensuring facility-related requests and issues are identified, appropriately routed, communicated, and followed through to resolution.

The Senior Facilities Operations Manager works closely with Facilities Managers who retain responsibility for hard facilities and technical building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, building controls, infrastructure, etc. This position coordinates the operational impact of that work and ensures continuity of office operations but does not replace the technical responsibilities of the Facilities Managers.

The role partners with Facilities, Real Estate, IT, EHS, Security, Procurement, HR and landlords/property managers among others to maintain consistent facilities service standards across the U.S. portfolio.

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in facilities operations, facilities services, corporate office operations, building services, or multi-site facilities environments.
* 5+ years of experience managing Office Managers, facilities coordinators, reception/front-of-house teams, day porters, or other site-based facilities operations personnel.
* Demonstrated experience managing the **day-to-day operation and service delivery** of corporate offices, including reception, janitorial, pantry/food service, office supplies, mail/shipping, conference rooms, common areas, and other facilities soft services.
* Experience establishing and maintaining consistent facilities operating standards, service levels, procedures, and inspection programs across multiple locations.
* Strong experience managing facilities service vendors, contracts, performance, service levels, and corrective actions.
* Demonstrated ability to manage staffing, scheduling, coverage, employee performance, accountability, and development of site operations teams.
* Experience working closely with IT, EHS, HR and Facilities Managers on r hard-facilities issues.
* Ability to recognize facilities issues, determine the appropriate escalation path, coordinate with technical resources, communicate impacts to office occupants, and follow issues through resolution.
* Experience coordinating office moves, restacks, openings, expansions, renovations, furniture changes, and other facilities-related operational changes.
* Experience managing facilities operating budgets, purchase orders, invoices, vendor contracts, forecasts, and operating expenses.
* Strong service orientation combined with the ability to maintain operational standards, accountability, consistency, and cost control.
* Strong communication and relationship-management skills with the ability to work effectively with employees, executives, Facilities Managers, landlords, vendors, and cross-functional teams.
* Highly organized, hands-on, responsive, and comfortable managing multiple locations and competing operational priorities.
Ability to travel regularly among assigned U.S. facilities.  

  

Pay is based on market location and may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education and other job-related reasons. The annual salary range for this position is $150,000.00-$1700,000.00.

(Applicable to California)

At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.

Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

**Role**

We are looking for a Staff Program Manager – Product Operations & NPI. This is a Hybrid (Santa Clara, CA office 3 days a week) role, reporting to the Vice President of Product Operations & NPI in the Product Management department. This role offers a massive opportunity to champion innovation and make a significant mark on the planning and product roadmap at the forefront of the world's cloud security leader by delivering never-before-seen capabilities in threat prevention, visibility, scalability, and business enablement.

**What you'll do (Role Expectations)**

* Leading and orchestrating the execution of multiple product development and launching programs to ensure timely delivery and high-quality outcomes.
* Acting as a central liaison for cross-functional alignment, addressing program risks, and resolving bottlenecks proactively to maximize the impact of Zscaler Product Innovation for internal/external stakeholders as well as sales/technical teams.
* Providing consistent updates to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on objectives and milestones.
* Optimizing operational processes to improve collaboration, scalability, and organizational impact
* Fostering a culture of iterative improvement by ensuring feedback is integrated into process refinements

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Operations, Program Management, or NPI; preferably in SaaS or cybersecurity industries
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex new product introductions and programs via Strong cross-functional coordination skills with exceptional communication.
* An exceptional communicator skilled in aligning cross-functional stakeholders while providing clear updates to senior leadership.

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency.
* A strategic thinker, focused on business outcomes, with a proven ability to orchestrate complex programs from inception to delivery while being an advocate for continuous improvement.
* A proactive problem-solver who identifies and mitigates risks, efficiently resolving bottlenecks to ensure program success while continuously supporting Zscaler Practice.

Team Metric is a vertically integrated residential design, development, and construction company serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We specialize in single-family residential projects, including new custom homes, major additions and remodels, ADUs, and other residential development projects.
