jobs.title: D365 Project Manager, Managed Services
jobs.description:
**Location** Virtual, home based office with travel

**Description**

The MCA Connect Project Manager in this role carries a blended portfolio. You will manage day to day support for live Dynamics 365 clients under Managed Services (MgS), manage the discrete enhancement and new functionality work those same clients buy, and direct one or more full life-cycle Dynamics 365 implementations from diagnosis through go-live and transition into support.

  

These three types of work are genuinely different disciplines.

* MgS live support is a queue to be managed against service commitments.
* New functionality and enhancement work is a series of small, fixed-scope projects that must be estimated, scheduled and billed without disturbing the support commitment.
* A full life-cycle implementation is a large, multi-phase program with its own team, budget and executive visibility.

  

The person in this role must be able to manage all three at once, switch cleanly between them, and protect each from the others.

  

You will be supported by a strong delivery team of solution architects, functional and technical consultants, and developers, but you will need a strong background in project management and business process optimization, and either a solid working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform or the capacity to build one quickly. Our projects are strategic investments for our clients. Their successful execution and their ongoing support both require a project manager who is driven, proactive, creative, assertive and relationship oriented.

  

While your primary function is project management, from time to time you may also be asked to assist with other functions including sales and marketing, implementation-related tasks, and general administration.

### **Responsibilities**

The responsibilities below are grouped into the disciplines common to every engagement, then the three work streams in turn, then the financial, communication and practice duties that run across all of them. Each group opens with what the work is and why it matters, followed by the specific tasks the role owns.

**Core project management, all work streams**
---------------------------------------------

A set of project management disciplines applies to every engagement you carry, whatever its size or commercial shape.

* Manage multiple concurrent client engagements, and own deliverables, scope and expectations on each of them.
* Provide leadership to all functional and business areas affected by the work.
* Develop and maintain project plans, cost estimates, resource plans, communication plans, risk mitigation plans and issue resolution plans.
* Drive project decisions and make recommendations to management about schedules, prioritization and resource allocation.
* Work with MCA Connect resource management to secure resources, and resolve the challenges between support needs, enhancement commitments and other milestones.
* Employ project management leading practices as provided by PMI and MCA Connect delivery standards.
* Drive client satisfaction across the portfolio and own the health relationship of every account you carry.

**MgS live support clients**
----------------------------

For an assigned portfolio of live Dynamics 365 clients, the work is a managed queue rather than a plan: tickets arrive on their own schedule to a support queue, and your job is to see that they are triaged correctly, worked by the right consultant, resolved inside the contracted commitment, and visible to the client throughout. Alongside the queue you monitor consumption against contract in period and raise the conversation about overage or change before the period closes rather than after.

* Own the service relationship for each assigned live client and act as their main point of accountability.
* Manage the client’s service desk tickets: triage, prioritization, assignment, aging, escalation and closure.
* Balance case load across the available consultant pool and keep the queue from concentrating on one person.
* Run regular service reviews covering ticket volumes and trends, consumption against the retainer or hours block, open risks and the forward plan.
* Manage environment optimization and management activities, including release and update readiness for Microsoft's service update cadence, environment refreshes and performance reviews.
* Monitor consumption against contract in period and flag over-consumption and under-consumption early.
* Drive the conversation about overage, carry-over or contract change before the period closes.
* Convert recurring incidents and chronic pain points into problem records, root cause work or scoped enhancement proposals.
* Maintain accurate case records, time capture and status in Symphony so reporting, invoicing and utilization figures reconcile without manual correction.
* Receive projects transitioning in from the implementation team and confirm documentation, environments, known issues and open items all transferred.

**New functionality and enhancement delivery**
----------------------------------------------

Live clients regularly buy work that is not support. Further work could be a customization, implement a new D365 module, an integration change, a business process review, or a training package. Each of these is a small project in its own right. The recurring tension in this stream is resource: enhancement work and the support queue draw on the same consultants, and you are expected to schedule around that rather than let one quietly starve the other.

* Qualify incoming requests, distinguish enhancements from support incidents, and route each to the right resources.
* Coordinate estimation with solution architects and consultants, and produce the scope, effort, schedule and price the client will approve.
* Secure written client approval of scope, cost and schedule before work begins.
* Schedule enhancement work packages against the same resource pool that carries the support

jobs.title: Infrastructure Program Manager – Energy Efficiency & Consolidation
jobs.description:
**About the client**  
Our client is a global leader in sustainable telecom network solutions, operating in the UK, Ireland, the USA and across Europe, Australia, South Africa and Brazil. They help extend the life of telecom networks through multi-vendor parts sourcing, responsible decommissioning and network engineering, with a strong focus on the circular economy and reducing environmental impact.

**Why this role matters**  
As a key member of the Infrastructure Program team, you'll lead delivery of a large-scale infrastructure efficiency, consolidation and decommissioning program across a complex telecommunications estate.

You'll coordinate infrastructure consolidation, energy-efficiency initiatives, DC power optimization, cooling efficiency, network shutdown and site exits. Your job is to bring multiple technical and operational workstreams together to deliver measurable energy, cost and infrastructure reductions with minimal operational disruption.

You'll be the central program owner, working across Infrastructure, Network Operations, Energy Efficiency, Engineering, Real Estate, Field Operations and external suppliers.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of the infrastructure efficiency, consolidation and decommissioning program
* Build and maintain the integrated program roadmap, milestones, dependencies and delivery plans
* Coordinate infrastructure, network, energy, HVAC/cooling, property and field-service workstreams
* Develop and manage site consolidation, infrastructure removal and site-exit plans
* Coordinate DC power and rectifier optimization, replacement, retrofit and consolidation
* Identify opportunities to reduce infrastructure power consumption and cooling overhead
* Coordinate network shutdown, migration and legacy equipment decommissioning
* Establish a single, validated site and asset baseline for planning and benefits measurement
* Manage program RAID, governance, budgets, forecasts and supplier performance
* Coordinate internal engineering teams, field resources, OEMs and third-party partners
* Track and report measurable benefits, including energy, infrastructure and operating cost reductions
* Provide clear reporting to senior stakeholders on progress, risks, finances and benefits
* Support business cases for infrastructure replacement, retrofit, reuse and recovery
* Maintain operational controls when working on live telecommunications infrastructure

**What we're looking for**

* Proven experience as a Program Manager or Senior Program Manager delivering complex infrastructure programs
* Background in telecommunications, data centers, critical infrastructure or similar environments
* Experience with large-scale consolidation, decommissioning, transformation or site-exit programs
* Strong understanding of DC power infrastructure and telecom rectifier environments
* Understanding of energy efficiency, power consumption and cooling optimization
* Experience coordinating multi-site field delivery and decommissioning
* Strong program governance, RAID, financial and benefits-management skills
* Strong analytical skills, including asset and site-level data
* Excellent communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders
* Strong commercial and supplier-management experience
* Good understanding of operational risk in live infrastructure environments

**Nice to have**

* Telecom DC power platforms such as Galaxy, Millennium, 596, Lorain, OmniOn/ABB and Vertiv
* HVAC and cooling in telecom or critical environments (EC fans, VFDs, airflow management, setpoint optimization)
* Legacy technology decommissioning, including TDM, voice and DACS
* Asset, inventory and site-management systems
* Energy and facilities data, including PUE and energy-consumption measurement
* Field-service, asset recovery and infrastructure logistics

**Contract details**

* W2 contract
* Remote, US-based, with occasional travel to sites as required
* Must be authorized to work in the US

Pay: From $80.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Application Question(s):

* How many years have you worked as a Program Manager on infrastructure programs?
* Have you delivered telecom, data center or critical infrastructure decommissioning or consolidation programs? Briefly describe the largest.
* Give an example of a high-pressure situation you managed at a senior level?

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Manager, Core
jobs.description:
**About First Due**

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Implementation Manager, Core**

**Location**: Remote - US Only  
**Country**: United States  
**Department**: Professional Services  
**Reports To**: Director, Professional Services  
**Position Type**: Full-Time  
**Salary**: $100,000

### **Job Summary:**

The Core Implementation Manager (Core IM) is the sole owner of a portfolio of roughly 40+ First Due Core implementations, typically multi-module engagements. These standard and moderately complex projects carry real configuration complexity and frequently include CAD integration and historical data migration, requiring disciplined project management, strong customer command, and the ability to direct several internal specialists toward a single go-live date.

The Core IM owns the customer relationship and every project in the portfolio from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, and is accountable for planned duration, scope, risk, customer communication, and time to value. This is a fully autonomous role: you are self-directed on all delivery decisions inside the signed SOW and involve leadership only on commercial and relationship exceptions. Core delivery runs on a paired model: the Implementation Manager owns the project, the assigned Implementation Consultant owns module configuration and functional product depth, and Technical Services owns integration and data migration execution.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own a full portfolio of roughly 40+ concurrent Core implementations from contract signature through go-live and handoff to Customer Success, consistently holding planned duration below team goal.
* Keep Rocketlane, the system of record, current always (plans, timelines, milestones, task status, owners, and dates) so any colleague can open a project and know exactly where it stands. Complete documentation and exit gates on time, not retroactively.
* Lead customer kickoffs with command: set clear expectations, correct unrealistic assumptions in the room, and close with an agreed action list, owners, and dates. Adapt the agenda to each agency’s politics and readiness based on Discovery.
* Run a progress cadence of at least bi-weekly check-ins on new acquisition projects and monthly on upsells, using each one to find and remove the real blocker rather than read status.
* Tailor each plan to the agency’s operational reality, including shift patterns, governance and approval cycles, budget calendars, and go-live blackout windows. Own multi-module sequencing, phasing, and dependency decisions across the platform.
* Direct and sequence the work of Implementation Consultants, Technical Services, Integrations, Support, and Product without direct authority, securing commitment on dates. Module configuration is owned by the assigned Implementation Consultant.
* Proactively surface product gaps, process gaps, communication silos, and methodology friction to leadership with supporting specifics and a proposed fix, and help own internal improvement efforts.

### **Qualifications:**

* This is a remote role, but the person hired must live in the US.
* 5+ years of experience managing customer-facing SaaS implementations (or 3+ years plus a master’s degree), including a portfolio of multiple concurrent projects.
* Strong public safety industry knowledge, including how fire, EMS, or law enforcement agencies operate and how decisions are made inside them.
* Demonstrated ownership of project plans, timelines, risk management, escalation recovery, and scope discipline, including change orders, on projects with multiple internal contributors.
* Proven ability to drive delivery outcomes through matrixed contributors without direct reporting authority.
* Working data literacy: comfortable reading record counts, spotting bad mappings, and assessing integration and migration risk.
* Experience with implementation project management tooling.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Excel.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise, actionable follow-ups, status reporting an executive stakeholder can act on, and delivering bad news early with a recommended path.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience working to billable utilization targets in a professional services organization.
* PMP, CAPM, or equivalent project management credential.
* Experience with fire, EMS, or law enforcement records management, CAD systems, or emergency services software.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce.
* Experience in a high-growth SaaS environment with evolving methodology and tooling.

**For US-based Roles**  
All applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer in the United States. Locality Media LLC is unable to sponsor or transition sponsorship ownership of employment visas at this time. Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. As part of the I-9 verification of authorization to work in the US, Locality Media participates in E-Verify.  
  
**Physical Demands and Work Environment**  
This role is fully remote with minimal travel expectations at this time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified employees and applicants to perform the essential functions as outlined above. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please reach out to people@firstdue.com.  
  
**Working at First Due**  
First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. Visit www.firstdue.c

● Experience managing projects or programs of similar size and complexity, including staffing and contract performance monitoring.

● Experience in workforce or organizational development, training, and process improvement.

● Experience developing policy for Defense or Air Force organizations in digital forensics, cybersecurity, or cyber threat analysis.

● Experience drafting executive communications for senior leaders and tracking performance metrics.

● Experience with cyber exercises, after-action reporting, risk assessments, and continuity planning.

● Proven ability to brief, advise, and produce decision-quality products for senior military and civilian leadership.

Bachelor’s degree in business, management, or a related field.

Active Top Secret/SCI clearance.

**Qualifications:**

* 2+ years managing recruiting or HR operations teams.
* Expertise in applicant tracking systems and HRIS platforms.
* Experience with Power Apps and SharePoint.

* Experience in multi-site, healthcare, or growth-oriented environments preferred.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Estimating
jobs.description:
Sevan Multi-Site Solutions is a veteran-owned business that provides construction, program management, real estate & site development, and architecture & engineering services for restaurant, grocery, fuel and convenience store, retail, and government sectors nationwide. We work with leading brands like McDonald’s, Starbucks, Sprouts, and BP, to name a few. At Sevan, we provide the talent, technology, and trusted expertise needed to consistently deliver excellence in multi-site construction.

*Sevan is nationally recognized for workplace culture, industry leadership, and safety. Recent honors include 12 consecutive years as a Great Place to Work®, placement on ENR's national Program and Construction Management rankings, recognition as one of America's Safest Companies for 2025, and the 2025 Platinum HIRE Vets Medallion Award.*

The **Project Coordinator** is part of a construction services team managing national multi-site commercial construction projects. The Project Coordinator provides administrative support to the Bid and Pipeline Manager throughout opportunity tracking and bidding, and assists the estimating team with subcontractor engagement.. Specific tasks are assigned by the Bid & Pipeline Manager, Sr. Bid Coordinator, or estimating team.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Manage and maintain accurate opportunity, bid, and pipeline information across company systems, ensuring project details, pursuit stages, deadlines, ownership, and anticipated schedules remain current.
* Coordinate bid calendars, deadlines, reviews, and follow-up activities across Estimating, Operations, and Business Development teams; proactively identify missing information, conflicting deadlines, and outstanding actions.
* Organize and maintain bid files and management platform records, including drawings, specifications, addenda, RFIs, proposals, correspondence, and other pursuit documentation.
* Coordinate subcontractor and supplier outreach by maintaining bidder lists, tracking participation and quote coverage, distributing bid invitations and addenda, and following up on outstanding responses.
* Track bid questions and clarification requests, coordinating responses with internal teams and distributing approved information to applicable bidders.
* Support preparation and submission of bids by coordinating required documents, forms, approvals, checklists, and client portal requirements.
* Prepare and distribute pipeline, bid status, and pursuit reports; document meeting outcomes and action items and follow up with responsible team members to maintain progress.
* Track bid outcomes, award status, and win/loss feedback; maintain historical pursuit records and coordinate the transition of awarded opportunities and documentation to the project execution team.
* Serve as a key administrative resource for the bidding and pipeline process, helping ensure opportunities move efficiently from initial pursuit through award while maintaining accurate records and clear communication across teams.
* Pricing, pursuit strategy, client commitments, and final bid approvals remain the responsibility of designated Estimating, Business Development, and leadership team members.

**Qualifications:**

* 2-4 construction or estimating experience and/or related training
* Experience with multi-site projects is preferred. Experience in construction administration, bid coordination, or opportunity and pipeline tracking is preferred.
* Knowledge of data analysis and tracking within Microsoft Excel and email and calendar management within Microsoft Outlook is required.
* Experience with Smartsheet and Procore is highly preferred.
* Familiarity with BuildingConnected or similar bid management platforms and CRM or pipeline tracking systems is preferred.
* Ability to use Microsoft Teams or similar tools for remote meetings, document sharing, and team coordination is required.

**Work Conditions and Travel:**

This is a remote position supporting construction, estimating, and business development teams. The employee must maintain a reliable internet connection and a workspace suitable for confidential business communications and focused work. The role requires effective collaboration through virtual meetings, email, and company systems; consistent availability during agreed working hours; and independent management of multiple projects, bid deadlines, and assigned priorities. Travel is required (0-10%) on an as-needed basis for project needs, team meetings, or training.

**Why Join Sevan?**

* Live Our Values: Join a company that values integrity, respect, teamwork, excellence, and charity. These principles are at the heart of everything we do.
* Champion Key Initiatives: Play a vital role in driving Sevan-wide initiatives like Safety and Sustainability, ensuring positive impacts for our people and the planet.
* Inspire and Lead: Help us bring our vision to life by embracing our commitment to Service, Talent, and Choices—you’ll have a voice in shaping the future.
* Set the Standard: Be a role model for professional behavior, fostering a workplace culture that motivates and inspires others.
* Grow With Us: Take charge of your personal and professional growth through hands-on experience, engaging training programs, and opportunities to mentor interns and co-ops.
* Support Development of Top Brands: Opportunity to work behind the scenes supporting efforts for industry leaders like McDonald’s, Starbucks, and 7-Eleven.

Pay & Benefits: The anticipated compensation range for the position is $27 - $34/hr based on a full-time schedule, market and business conditions, and is commensurate on individual education, qualifications, and experience. jobs.title: Energy Product Analyst - Customer Care
jobs.description:

This position is responsible for serving multiple constituents, both internally and externally, as experts within the energy industry and MCG’s product portfolio. An EPA – Customer Care’s primary role is to work with Account Coordinators, Development Team, Application Support staff, and customers to provide subject matter expertise in the areas of the energy industry and MCG’s products to facilitate customers achieving maximum benefit and satisfaction in their use of MCG’s products.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* This role is ultimately responsible for the retention and satisfaction of each MCG customer.
* Collaborate closely with MCG Account Coordinators to address customer inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally.
* Foster and nurture enduring relationships with key stakeholders at client companies, including users, managers, and executives.
* Build and maintain strong, long-lasting, personal relationships with users, managers, and executives at customer companies.
* Proactively identify opportunities for growth within existing client accounts.
* Work closely with clients to understand their evolving needs and offer scalable solutions that align with their strategic objectives.
* Drive the expansion of MCG's presence within client organizations, leveraging existing relationships and delivering exceptional customer experiences.
* Consult with others and provides input to company software roadmap, including software assurance guarantees. Those others include:
* Market technical forums
* Industry conferences and exhibits
* Internal market monitoring team, product design team, technical staff, sales and marketing professionals and executive leadership team.
* Participate as implementation team member.
* Document customer requirements accurately and effectively, ensuring clarity and alignment.
* Configure software applications according to customer specifications, adhering to best practices and industry standards.
* In all cases, behave ethically and legally with all peers, contacts, and customers.

This individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, education, and/or ability required.

* Strong knowledge of CAISO market rules, scheduling processes, and grid operations.
* Proven experience navigating wholesale power markets, day-ahead and real-time markets, and congestion management protocols. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to assess customer needs and provide effective solutions.
* Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines and delivering high-quality results.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and configuration of software applications.

**Preferred Skills:**

* In-depth understanding of software implementation processes and methodologies.
* Proven experience navigating wholesale power markets, day-ahead and real-time markets, and congestion management protocols. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

**Leadership Skills:**

jobs.title: Program Manager, Quality, AIS
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

This role provides quality oversight for AI and machine learning-enabled medical devices, including SaMD. The position supports the full product lifecycle, from design and development through software release, design transfer and post-market activities. Working across engineering, clinical, regulatory and program teams, the role applies design controls, risk management and quality-system requirements to ensure patient safety, product quality and compliance. It also supports investigations, CAPAs, audit remediation and continuous improvement while using sound technical judgement to resolve complex quality issues.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Creates and promotes a strong quality culture by driving quality and compliance activities for AI-enabled medical devices, including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD). Responsible for ensuring compliance with the applicable Quality Management System, driving quality objectives and metrics, and supporting effective quality operating mechanisms across the business.
* Provides quality oversight throughout the product lifecycle, including new product introduction, design and development, design changes, software releases, design transfer and post-market activities. Ensures quality and regulatory compliance while supporting process effectiveness and efficiency.
* Develops in-depth knowledge of AI-enabled medical devices and their integration with compatible medical-device platforms. Uses prior experience and technical expertise to support quality strategy, risk-based decision-making, verification and validation, and the effective application of design controls.
* Partners with software engineering, machine learning, clinical, regulatory, product and program teams to provide quality guidance for AI-enabled medical-device development. Communicates complex quality and technical information clearly and provides guidance to less-experienced team members.
* Impacts projects, processes and procedures within the quality function and operates with appropriate autonomy. Uses professional judgement to identify and address quality and compliance risks, while seeking senior guidance for complex or high-impact matters when needed.
* Utilizes technical expertise and analytical thinking to resolve quality issues and support investigations, nonconformances, CAPAs, audit remediation and continuous-improvement activities. Leverages multiple internal sources and cross-functional input to make informed decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college (OR a high school diploma / GED with at least 10 years of experience.)
* 6+ years of experience

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Experience supporting AI or machine learning-enabled medical devices, including considerations related to data quality, model performance, traceability, validation, change control and integration with medical-device platforms.
* Experience in quality assurance or design quality for medical devices, including SaMD, with working knowledge of design controls, software lifecycle processes, risk management, verification, validation and post-market quality activities.

  
We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $106,400.00-$159,600.00 Annual. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

**Additional Information**

jobs.title: Test Manager - Quality Assurance | United States | Fully Remote | Wednesday - Sunday
jobs.description:
**What we are looking for:**

  

**Important:** For this role we are only considering US-based candidates who are able & willing to work from Wednesday to Sunday every week.

  

We are seeking a highly motivated Test Manager to lead Quality Assurance for a AAA game development team. You will lead embedded testing teams, and partner with cross-functional leadership to balance quality, schedule, and risk in a complex development environment.

  

**What we will do together:**

  

QA Strategy & Leadership

* Define global QA strategy, test objectives, quality gates, and risk-based testing methodologies for major project milestones.
* Integrate QA into early development planning to ensure quality is a core part of the feature lifecycle rather than just final validation.

  

People Management

* Mentor and develop a high-performing team of QA Leads and testers, fostering a culture of ownership and collaboration.
* Manage both internal and external QA resources effectively to meet project demands.

  

Test Planning & Execution

* Oversee comprehensive test execution across functional, gameplay, performance, stability, multiplayer, and platform certification areas.
* Monitor defect trends and quality risks, ensuring critical issues are prioritized and driven to resolution.

  

Defect & Risk Management

* Analyze defect data to identify systemic quality issues and drive root-cause analysis and preventative initiatives.
* Communicate emerging quality risks and technical assessments clearly to Production and project leadership.

  

Milestone & Release Management

* Establish QA schedules and deliverables for major milestones, providing objective assessments of build stability and release readiness.
* Coordinate final regression and stabilization efforts during high-pressure release periods.

  

Platform Certification

* Lead preparation for first-party certification, coordinating test plans and tracking submission risks to ensure successful launches.

  

Cross-Functional Leadership

* Advocate for quality as the senior QA representative within project leadership, balancing technical standards with production constraints.
* Build strong partnerships across disciplines to establish a shared responsibility for quality across the entire development team.

  

External & Co-Development QA

* Manage external vendors and co-development QA teams, defining expectations and reporting standards to ensure seamless integration with internal strategy.

  

QA Tools, Metrics & Process Improvement

* Implement data-driven reporting and dashboards to track build health, test coverage, and milestone progress.
* Continuously improve QA efficiency through automation, tooling, and process retrospectives.

  

**What you will bring:**

* 7+ years in software QA with 3+ years managing teams in game development.
* Proven track record of shipping at least one major AAA title across the full development lifecycle.
* Expertise in developing test strategies, risk-based testing, and Agile methodologies.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership.

  

Nice to have

* Experience with Unreal audio features (e.g., Audio Mixer, MetaSounds, Sound Cues, Submixes, Quartz, spatialization plugins).
* Experience with platform-specific audio constraints and certification considerations.
* Experience building editor tools and pipeline automation.
* Experience supporting large-scale content teams and multi-project shared technology.
* Experience with console certification, multiplayer/online services, and live-service operations.
* Familiarity with Jira, TestRail, and technical QA solutions like automation and telemetry.

**Interested… a bit about Escape Velocity:**

Escape Velocity is a team of passionate, talented developers working at a studio that offers excellent benefits, on what we believe is a once-in-a-career project with a committed publisher. But that doesn't necessarily make us unique. What does make us special? We value the time, energy, and talent of our players and our colleagues. We want every hour spent developing and playing our games to be an incredibly rewarding and worthwhile use of your time. To that end, we are 'Fully Remote' and support team members nearly anywhere in the world. We prioritize honesty, even when that means sharing bad news. We strive to give everyone autonomy so they can determine how best to work and play, and we care more about what you bring to the game and studio than how many hours you're clocking. We're dedicated to building a culture of play, which not only makes us better game makers, but also strengthens the bonds between us all. We believe in constant improvement across all areas – from the game itself to our production design – and are constantly re-evaluating how we spend our time to ensure that we're not wasting yours and we're all always working on the most important things.

  

**A few benefits you can expect from us:**

* A generous PTO allowance

* Summer and Winter holidays studio closure (separate to PTO allowance)

* Private Medical & Dental Healthcare

* Private Mental Health scheme

* A generous annual Health & Wellbeing allowance

* Discretionary Studio Bonus

* Top range tech for your home set up

* Other benefits based on your region

  

**How to apply:**

Click apply and complete an application along with a Resume / CV. If we would like to move forward with your application, a member of the Recruiting Team will reach out to you and guide you through our process.

Escape Velocity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to hiring, promoting, and compensating employees based on their qualifications and demonstrated ability to perform job responsibilities.

Applications will be considered regardless of age, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, belief, race, or any other protected category.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a **Account Manager** to serve as a primary point of contact for orthopedic practices and patients utilizing Kinomatic’s presurgical planning solutions. This role delivers an exceptional, high-touch experience by reinforcing the surgeon’s recommendation, educating patients on their available options, guiding them through the decision-making process, and helping them understand the value of investing in Kinomatic’s advanced technology. The Account Manager also coordinates patient-related workflows and ensures practices receive responsive, accurate, and proactive support.

The ideal candidate is passionate about excellence and understands what it means to provide concierge-level service in a fast-paced healthcare technology environment. This individual excels at patient education, consultative sales, relationship building, and anticipating patient needs, while confidently communicating the value of an elective technology that requires an investment beyond what is covered by insurance. They are skilled at listening to patient goals and concerns, answering questions, navigating objections, and helping patients make informed decisions that are right for them.

Through strong relationship management, attention to detail, empathetic consultative selling, and a commitment to service excellence, this role helps strengthen partnerships, support patient conversion and account growth, improve operational efficiency, and support Kinomatic’s mission to improve surgical outcomes through innovative technology.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with patients, surgeons, orthopedic practices, office managers, and clinical staff across assigned accounts.
* Serve as a high-touch point of contact for patients and orthopedic practices, providing responsive, proactive, and solution-oriented support.
* Educate patients on Kinomatic’s surgical planning technology, benefits, and associated investment, helping them understand the value of choosing advanced technology beyond their standard insurance-covered options.
* Conduct empathetic, consultative conversations with patients to understand their needs, answer questions, address concerns, and guide them toward an informed decision.
* Support the onboarding of new orthopedic practices and educate practice staff on Kinomatic’s surgical planning processes.
* Coordinate between Kinomatic, orthopedic practices, and patients throughout the surgical planning process to ensure a seamless experience.
* Support patient navigation by scheduling CT scans, tracking patient progress, and ensuring surgical plans are finalized prior to surgery.
* Ensure patient documentation, including consent forms, are completed, signed, and accurately entered into Salesforce CRM.
* Partner with practice staff to ensure accurate and timely lead submission, surgical date reconciliation, Salesforce CRM updates, and account reporting.
* Identify opportunities to improve patient engagement, education, conversion, and overall account performance.
* Work cross-functionally with clinical, product, and engineering teams to enhance the patient, surgeon, and practice experience.
* Identify and share patient, surgeon, and practice insights to support account growth, marketing initiatives, and customer success storytelling.

**Education**

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Healthcare Administration, or related field preferred.

Relevant experience supporting physician practices, consulting with patients, selling healthcare services, coordinating patient workflows, managing healthcare client relationships, or supporting clinical operations may substitute for formal education.

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* 3+ years of experience in consultative sales, client success, account management, sales support, care coordination, or relationship management, preferably within healthcare, medical technology, or a clinical practice environment.
* Shown capacity to manage high-touch patient interactions, anticipate client needs, resolve complex issues, and deliver a premium service experience to patients, physicians, clinical teams, and practices.
* Demonstrated ability to educate and guide customers through a consultative sales process, particularly when presenting elective or premium healthcare services that require an investment beyond standard insurance coverage.
* Experience supporting account growth, lead development, client onboarding, and ongoing account engagement in partnership with sales, clinical, and operational teams.
* Ability to analyze account activity, identify trends or service gaps, and recommend solutions that improve client experience, operational efficiency, and account performance.
* Strong judgment, professionalism, and communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with patients, surgeons, practice leaders, and internal stakeholders.
* Exceptional listening, empathy, and objection-handling skills, with the ability to build trust and communicate the value of advanced healthcare technology without creating a transactional or high-pressure sales experience.
* Proven ability to independently manage competing priorities, make sound decisions, and drive follow-through in a fast-paced, high-touch service environment.
* Experience maintaining accurate client, patient, account, and workflow documentation in CRM or related systems; Salesforce experience preferred.
* Ability to maintain a quiet, professional, and distraction-free workspace suitable for confidential phone calls and high-quality patient and provider interactions.
* Occasional travel may be required to support clinical team needs, practice onboarding, and account relationship activities; travel is limited.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in the Healthcare Services, Medtech or Medical Sales industries.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.
* Experience working with Salesforce, Asana, EHR systems, or other workflo

jobs.description:
**Date:** Oct 7, 2026

**Location:** Remote - East Coast US, US

**Company:** Bausch+Lomb Companies Inc.

Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better.

  

Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries, extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future.

**Objective:**

  

The Regional Account Manage-Market Access (RAM) will execute the payor strategy within an assigned region to secure and maintain favorable coverage, coding, and reimbursement across commercial plans, Medicare Advantage (MedAdv), and Medicaid in assigned states. This role reports to the National Payor Account Director (East / West) and will drive access for Surgical Glaucoma products, influence payer policy, and enable provider adoption and patient access. This role will establish and maintain payor relationships, i.e., Medical Director and medical policy staff, resolving reimbursement barriers, and ensuring appropriate and consistent payment.

The RAM will also serve as a reimbursement liaison as needed and collaborate with cross-functional colleagues in Sales, Medical Affairs, and the HUB provider to educate physicians and institutional customers in local payor policy requirements. RAM-Glaucoma will serve as a subject-matter expert in regional payor policy for MIGS devices for medical benefit. The RAM will proactively engage with medical directors, state agencies, and advocacy groups in the assigned region to build sustainable coverage pathways and support future technologies B+L brings to the market. Extensive field engagement and travel required.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute regional payor strategies to secure and maintain coverage, coding, and reimbursement across Commercial, Medicare Advantage and Medicaid as required.
* Partner with Sales teams to educate and support customers by removing access barriers and resolve complex reimbursement challenges.
* Conduct reimbursement seminars via videoconference or in person on local payor coverage criteria and requirements for appropriate reimbursement of B+L Surgical Glaucoma products.
* Build and sustain relationships with payor medical directors, state agencies, and advocacy organizations to influence policy and coverage decisions.
* Serve as the regional payor and reimbursement subject-matter expert for assigned payors - guiding internal teams and customers on medical device reimbursement, coding, billing, and appeals processes.
* Understand and work with key health care stakeholders within the following customers: Commercial Managed Care (Regional Plans), Medicare Advantage (MedAdv), Medicaid (Fee for Service) as needed, State Ophthalmic Medical Groups, State Advocacy, patient, provider, and other key healthcare stakeholder groups.
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required, advanced degree in life science, business and ophthalmology experience preferred.

* 5 plus years of industry experience in payor/reimbursement roles within medical devices and Part B coverage
* Minimum 2 years’ experience in ophthalmic practice management, practice billing, and revenue cycle, public or private third-party reimbursement related to MIGS and their impact on providers, ASCs, and hospitals.
* Ability to interpret MAC LCDs and Articles related to MIGS and seek enforcement of CMS regulations as they pertain to Medicare Advantage plans.
* Proven experience with payor strategy, reimbursement, and account management; direct product launch experience highly desirable
* Deep knowledge of Commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid reimbursement structures, coding (i.e., CPT, ICD-10 codes), billing, and appeals processes.
* Strong executive presence and stakeholder engagement skills with payors, KOLs, hospital systems

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.  
.

**Hiring and how we work**

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.  
.

**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development

**About the job**

This position is needed to build and lead the live learning experiences that shape how Twilions grow, lead, and work together. You will design and facilitate Twilio's development programs, design and lead leadership team offsites, and serve as an internal coach to leaders and emerging talent around the globe.

  

Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Development, you will spend most of your time in the room, virtual or in person, with Twilions: designing programs, facilitating sessions, guiding leadership teams through high-stakes offsites, and coaching leaders through pivotal growth moments. The ideal candidate is an expert facilitator and credentialed coach who designs with rigor, reads a room in real time, and turns every session into measurable behavior change.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* Design and build facilitated development programs end to end, from needs assessment and learning objectives through facilitator guides, participant materials, and experiential activities, for leaders, managers, and individual contributors globally.
* Facilitate Twilio's development programs in person, virtually, and in hybrid formats, delivering engaging, inclusive sessions that build skills and shift behavior across a global, remote-first workforce.
* Design and facilitate leadership team offsites and team effectiveness sessions, partnering with senior leaders to define outcomes, build agendas, guide strategic conversations, and drive clear commitments and follow-through.
* Serve as an internal coach to leaders and high-potential talent, delivering one-on-one and team coaching engagements and embedding coaching into development programs to reinforce learning.
* Build internal facilitation capability by developing and certifying a bench of facilitators, and set the design and delivery standards for Talent Development programs.
* Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to diagnose capability gaps and determine whether training, coaching, or a facilitated team intervention is the right solution.
* Measure the impact of programs, offsites, and coaching through participant feedback, behavior change, and business outcomes, and use the data to continuously iterate.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  

* **Required:**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Adult Learning, Education, or a related field preferred.
* 7-10 years in talent development, with 7+ years designing and facilitating leadership, manager, and professional development programs.
* Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating executive and leadership team offsites, including strategic planning, team alignment, and team effectiveness sessions.
* Expert facilitation skills across in-person, virtual, and hybrid formats, with the ability to engage diverse global audiences and navigate challenging group dynamics in real time.
* Strong instructional design skills grounded in adult learning principles, including building facilitator guides and programs that scale through train-the-trainer models.
* Executive presence with the ability to build trust quickly, deliver candid feedback, and maintain strict confidentiality with senior leaders.
* Experience using learning and coaching data, including feedback, behavior change, and business metrics, to demonstrate impact and drive program decisions.
* Willingness to travel for in-person programs and offsites (approx. 25%).

**Desired:**

* Certification in assessment tools such as Hogan, DiSC, MBTI, or 360-degree feedback instruments.
* Experience building an internal coaching program or a facilitator certification pathway.
* Experience applying AI tools to accelerate program design, personalize learning, or extend the reach of coaching.
* Ability to effectively prioritize a full facilitation and coaching calendar in a fast-paced, ever-changing culture.

  

**Location**

jobs.description:
About Us:

Eagleview is a leading provider of aerial imagery, property insights and software that transforms the way people work. Eagleview holds more than 300 patents and owns a large geospatial data and imagery library encompassing 94 percent of the US population. Eagleview provides the most accurate data, enabling customers in the government, construction, solar and insurance industries to make timely, informed and better decisions.

Overview:

The Technical Account Manager in Account Management plays a critical, client-facing role focused on managing a portfolio of technical customers to drive retention, satisfaction, and revenue growth. Acting as the primary point of contact, this role ensures technical clients are successfully onboarded, supported, and engaged throughout the customer lifecycle. The Account Manager collaborates cross-functionally to align internal resources and deliver a seamless customer experience that fosters long-term success—particularly within complex, technical environments.

We are a fast paced, energetic team driven by continuous process improvement. We’re looking for motivated, organized, and independent team members. This position requires good communication skills and the ability to quickly pick up new technologies.

**This is a full-time, remote (territory) role with a base salary of $55,000-70,000, and a commission target of $30,000.**

**Applicant must live within a reasonable distance of a major airport in Florida, Georgia, Alabama, or South Carolina.**

Responsibilities:

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary liaison for assigned technical customer accounts, fostering trust and accountability across all touchpoints.
* Conduct regular check-ins and lead Strategic Business Reviews to assess engagement, performance, and solution alignment.
* Understand each customer’s technical goals, success metrics, IT architecture, and integration requirements to deliver proactive support and guidance.
* Ability to travel up to 50% of the time throughout the defined territory.
* Assist with Technical sales presentations.

**Retention & Growth**

* Monitor account health and customer satisfaction, addressing risks and removing technical or process-related barriers to success.
* Identify and escalate upsell and cross-sell opportunities in collaboration with the Sales team.
* Support timely renewal discussions and collaborate on securing customer commitments.
* Drive account strategies that directly contribute to Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) by mitigating churn risks and maximizing customer value from a technical perspective.
* Understand the customer environment to assure maximum deployment across the organization.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with internal teams (Onboarding, Support, Product, Engineering, and Marketing) to ensure consistent customer experience and technical alignment.
* Ensure that all available customer integrations are configured.
* Identify and facilitate all opportunities for training.
* Champion the voice of the technical customer internally, providing feedback to influence product enhancements, documentation, and implementation support.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of customer activity, engagement, and solution health using Salesforce, Gainsight, and other relevant tools.
* Track and report on key performance indicators, including GRR, Strategic Business Reviews, qualified opportunities, customer advocacy, and internal collaboration.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
* 2+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related client-facing technical role.
* Strong communication, technical problem-solving, and relationship management skills.
* Familiarity with GIS technologies, IT systems, APIs, or enterprise integration workflows.
* Applicant must live within a reasonable distance of a major airport in **Florida, Georgia, Alabama, or South Carolina.**

**Preferred**

* Experience in SaaS, cloud services, or other technology-enabled environments.
* Proficiency with CRM and customer success platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight, HubSpot).

The Specialist handles routine questions or escalates complex issues to the right internal team, seeing things through to resolution. They keep a pulse on their assigned customers, flagging at-risk accounts early to prevent churn. The role works closely with Sales, Support, and Implementation to provide a coordinated customer experience where nothing falls through the cracks.

Customer Success & Retention

* Support a portfolio of customer accounts through onboarding, adoption, and renewal, building day-to-day working relationships with account contacts
* Serve as the first point of contact for assigned accounts, responding to questions and resolving common issues directly

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
**About One Door**

One Door is a profitable, established enterprise SaaS company whose platform runs merchandising and in-store execution for some of the largest carrier, banking and retail networks in the world. Our customers use One Door to keep hundreds or thousands of physical locations (stores, branches, retail doors) consistent, on-brand and measurable.

**The Role**

You will own a portfolio of our largest customers: national wireless carriers, retail banks and global retailers, with individual accounts worth more than $1M a year. You are accountable for keeping them, growing them, and making sure they get the value they are paying for.

Some of these customers are unhappy today, and we need someone who runs toward that. You will sit across from a frustrated executive, understand what is really going wrong, work out the solution with our technical team, and rebuild the relationship until they see you as a trusted advisor rather than a vendor contact. If you have only ever managed happy accounts, this is not the role for you.

This is a senior, hands-on role reporting to our Chief Customer Officer. You will be the executive relationship owner and the single point of accountability for each account: renewals, expansion, escalations, and the internal follow-through across our product, engineering and delivery teams.

**What You Will Do**

* Own renewal and expansion targets across a named portfolio of enterprise accounts.
* Build and maintain relationships with executive sponsors, operations leaders and day-to-day users at each account.
* Run account plans, executive business reviews and success metrics that show the customer measurable value.
* Take ownership of unhappy and at-risk accounts: get to the root of the problem, agree a recovery plan with the customer, and see it through until trust is rebuilt.
* Scope client needs accurately from what customers tell you, and turn them into clear product requirements documents (PRDs) for our engineering team.
* Work with our Client Solutions Architect to design solutions to customer problems, check technical feasibility, and set realistic expectations on what can be delivered and when.

jobs.title: EverHealth - Process Improvement Manager (Remote, US)
jobs.description:
**EverHealth Process Improvement Manager**

EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications.

EverHealth is hiring a Process Improvement Manager to join a team rebuilding how work gets done across our healthcare software brands, including DrChrono, CollaborateMD, Updox, and eProvider Solutions. You will embed with a business function, in areas like go-to-market, customer success, customer experience, or operations, establish what the current process actually is, measure it, and redesign it.

  
  

Most of the functions we work with have processes that are undocumented, inconsistently followed, or built around constraints that no longer exist. Automating those as they stand would only make the problem run faster. Your job is to find the real constraint, fix the process, and hand a clean design to the engineers who build on top of it.

  
  

It suits someone who has run operational improvement work end to end, is comfortable sitting with a team and watching them work rather than relying on a process document, and can defend a redesign with evidence in front of a function leader.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

**Map the Current State**

* Reconstruct how a function works today through interviews, shadowing, and system data, at a level of detail the team recognizes as accurate.

* Separate elapsed time from touch time so the difference between work and waiting is visible, not assumed.

* Document the handoffs, queues, decision points, and exceptions that the official process does not describe.
  

  

**Measure and Baseline**

* Pull real duration, volume, and rework data from the systems a function runs on, rather than relying on self-reported estimates.

* Establish a defensible baseline for every engagement before any change is made, so improvement can be attributed rather than claimed.

* Define the operating metrics a function will run on after the engagement ends, and the definition behind each number.
  

  

**Redesign the Process**

* Design the future state from the constraint outward: flow, queue discipline, sequencing, ownership, and the gates that hold quality.

* Decide what should be eliminated, what should be standardized, and only then what should be automated.

* Pressure-test a redesign against real cases and edge cases before it is rolled out, not after.
  

  

**Drive Adoption and Change**

* Work directly with function leaders and frontline teams so a redesign is adopted rather than announced.

* Build the training, standard work, and manager routines that keep a new process in place once the team moves on.

* Track whether a change held after handoff, and go back in when it did not.
  

  

**Partner Across the Business**

* Partner with our engineers so the build starts from a corrected process, and flag when a proposed build would automate a problem instead of solving it.

* Work with Finance to agree on how savings and capacity are defined and counted before results are reported.

* Build a repeatable method across engagements so the fifth function moves faster than the first.
  

  

**Skills and Experience Needed for Success in This Role**

* 5+ years in process improvement, operational excellence, business process consulting, or a hands-on operations leadership role with responsibility for redesigning how work is done.

* Demonstrated experience mapping a complex, multi-team process end to end and delivering a measured improvement, with numbers you can speak to.

* Strong quantitative skills. You can pull, clean, and interrogate operational data yourself in a spreadsheet or BI tool without waiting on an analyst.

* Skilled interviewer and observer who can get past what people say the process is to what it actually is.

* Working knowledge of flow and queue concepts, cycle time, work in progress, and constraint analysis, and the judgment to know which one applies.

* Credible with both frontline teams and executives, and able to hold a position when a redesign is unpopular.

* Clear, plain writer. Your maps, findings, and recommendations need to stand on their own after you leave the room.

* Comfortable with ambiguity and with being the first person to look closely at a function nobody has examined before.
  

  

**Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare technology, SaaS, or another regulated environment.

* Formal training in Lean, Six Sigma, or an equivalent improvement method, applied in practice rather than held as a certificate.

* Experience in implementation, onboarding, revenue cycle, support, or another high-volume operational function.

* Familiarity with CRM and project or work management systems, and with the data they produce.

* Experience working alongside a technical team on automation or AI projects.

* Change management experience where a redesign had to survive a leadership transition or a reorganization.
  

  

**Where:** The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. **This role can be based anywhere in the United States.** Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this posi

Keysight’s EDA experts work alongside customers to solve demanding technical challenges, accelerate innovation, and bring breakthrough technologies to market with greater confidence.

This is an opportunity for an accomplished EDA professional who wants to combine deep technical expertise with customer leadership, business insight, and program ownership. You will do more than support software: you will help influence how leading engineering organizations solve complex design challenges while shaping the future of Keysight’s software strategy.

* Develop a thorough understanding of each customer’s design environment, including its workflows, technical challenges, software usage, organizational priorities, and opportunities for broader adoption.

* Coordinate solutions engineers, services, support, product specialists, and other subject-matter experts to address customer needs, prioritize work, and ensure commitments are completed.
* Serve as the voice of the customer to the Keysight Factory, communicating software defects, product requirements, and enhancement opportunities to Keysight’s product and development organizations and helping drive them toward resolution.
* Promote new products, features, and New Product Introduction (NPI) initiatives through customer events, technical demonstrations, evaluations, and design-flow engagements.
* Advance key Keysight technology initiatives, including 5G, RF and Microwave (RFMW), High-Speed Digital (HSD), photonics, and other emerging design technologies, by connecting new capabilities to relevant customer challenges and workflows.
* Identify and develop opportunities for design-flow wins, additional license adoption, services engagements, and broader deployment of Keysight solutions across customer teams and locations.
* Partner with account managers and technical teams to develop account plans, customer strategies, and coordinated coverage that support adoption, retention, and account growth.
* Measure and communicate customer outcomes, including proof of value, software adoption, usage growth, design-flow wins, customer health, retention, and expansion.

Program: Eddy Street Apartments  
Location: Tenderloin, San Francisco  
Reports To: Deputy Director of Housing Support Services

Community Forward SF is a collection of vital programs that ensures our neighbors experiencing  
homelessness have effective services designed for their unique needs. Whether one needs  
housing, medical shelter, a safe place to recover, or calm in the face of domestic violence – we care  
for those most vulnerable in our community. We are not just one program. We are a network of  
programs designed to work together to meet every stage of need. We focus on the  
hardest-to-reach, most vulnerable people: Women, Medical Crisis, Substance Use Disorder, and  
Older Adults. Our programs meet the needs of people, rather than demanding that people meet

Community Forward SF is hiring a Case Manager II. The Case Manager II primarily supports

also provides case management and housing stabilization support to permanent supportive  
housing (PSH) residents at Eddy Street Apartments.  
The Case Manager partners with residents to identify strengths, needs, and self-defined goals and  
provides person-centered support to promote health, housing stability, safety, and  
self-determination. Services include case management assessment and service planning,  
therapeutic engagement, housing stabilization and transition support, advocacy, benefits

resident-identified goals, helps residents navigate housing, health care, behavioral health, benefits,

specialized support is needed.

program, program expectations, available services, staff, and community resources.

Service Plans (ISPs) based on case management assessment and centered on  
resident-identified goals, strengths, needs, individual timelines, and personal choices.

You'll run the building, its vendors, our events and the community around them, and you'll work as EA to one of our founders.

Expect to spend around 40% of your time on office and facilities: letting vendors in, testing their fixes, and receiving and installing deliveries. Another 30% goes to events and community, where you run our event series and grow the community that comes out of it. The last 30% is vendor and executive coordination. You track each open item in writing until you close it. You'll do most of this work on site at our SF HQ.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**1. Property management and maintenance (daily)**

* Act as our single point of contact with the landlord and property manager. File maintenance requests through their portal, follow up on walkthroughs and chase each ticket until it closes.

* Follow the escalation rules: send routine requests by email or portal, and save texts to the property manager for emergencies.

**2. Vendors and building systems (daily)**

* Set the weekly cadence for cleaning, laundry, restocking and trash days so the team walks into a ready office each morning.

**3. Purchasing and receiving (several times a week)**

* Run the office purchase list. Confirm items, quantities and deadlines, check what we've already ordered, and place orders across Amazon, Home Depot, Costco, Instacart and local stores.
* Receive packages, chase missed or returned deliveries with the carrier, and handle returns.
* Install mounts, AV, lighting, furniture and signage, or bring in someone who can.

**4. Event operations (weekly, heavy in event weeks)**

* Run event operations for anything from a 30-person dinner to a 500+ RSVP party: catering, licensed bartenders and drink tickets, DJ and AV, furniture, check-in and cleanup.

* Scout and book outside venues when an event outgrows our space. Keep a vendor list with quotes on file so you can plan each event faster and for less money.

**5. Community, offline and online (weekly)**

* Help run our offline community. You'll host a steady series of events and turn first-time guests into regulars, and regulars into core members.
* Track who comes, who comes back and who brings friends. Follow up with the good ones so they return after their first night.
* Move people from our events into our online community (group chats, Discord or Slack, and newsletters), and keep that space active between events.
* After each event, report RSVPs, show rate, new members and repeat attendees.

**6. Facilities and security policy (as needed)**

* Set and enforce building rules for package handling, door access and guests, plus a stopgap plan for the period before cameras and alarms go live.

**7. EA and executive operations for one of our founders (constant)**

* Turn the founder's quick notes and voice memos into tracked tasks with owners and dates.
* Handle day-to-day errands, purchases, scheduling, logistics and vendor calls so the founder can spend their time on the company.
* Write clear vendor and landlord emails in English, run follow-up checks, and flag a risk as soon as you see it.
* Turn recurring problems into checklists, runbooks, vendor rosters and trackers so you solve each problem once.

**Who you are**
---------------

* You have several years running office, facilities, hospitality or venue operations at a startup, hotel, venue or event space, and you've run a building day to day.
* You have a track record of events you ran, with results you can point to. A recurring series counts for more than one-offs.
* You've built an offline community. Across many events, you turned first-time guests into regulars and grew a core group that keeps showing up.
* You've run an online community, moved people into it from in-person events and kept it active.
* You have a network to call on. If we need catering for 80 on Thursday, a deep clean after a party, a laundry service or a fire-alarm tech, you know who to call or how to find them fast.
* You have hands-on crowd control and stage management experience from packed, intense events: DJ nights, club nights or concerts.
* You're comfortable with building systems and event safety: alarms, access control, capacity, bar service and waivers.

new_jobs.description:
Blackhawk Country Club will be the premier full-service club in the East Bay, where members gather as a community and create lifelong connections through exceptional experiences in an incomparably beautiful setting.

As a member of the Blackhawk Country Club team, you play an integral role in advancing our Club’s Vision and Strategic Plan. You will be expected to adhere to our "6B's," which outline the fundamental expectations we have of every employee. Additionally, we rely on you to embody our HAWKS CODE culture, bringing it to life through your language, attitude, and actions.

At Blackhawk Country Club’s Fitness and Wellness Center, hospitality is at the heart of everything we do. The Fitness Operations Supervisor plays a key role in delivering an exceptional member experience by supporting the day-to-day operations of the Fitness and Wellness Center. This position will take ownership of the front desk operation and serve as the primary liaison between members and staff. Key responsibilities include ensuring smooth communication, a welcoming environment, and consistent service excellence. With a focus on safety, cleanliness, and hospitality, this role sets the tone for the club’s service standards and supports the fitness leadership team in maintaining a five-star experience.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays
* Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a warm, service-minded approach
* Strong passion for cleanliness, safety and hospitality excellence
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with a flexible, team-first mindset
