new_jobs.title: Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Title:**
==========

Operations Manager

**Job Description:**
====================

**Job Overview**

The Operations Manager will be responsible for directing company programs and implementing company policy to ensure total compliance with contract duties between company and customer.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

To perform this job successfully and safely, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.

* Plans and develops work schedules to ensure adequate service.
* Prepares schedules for service personnel, assigns personnel to routes.
* Inspects and evaluates physical condition of establishment for program compliance, i.e. safety, quality, and service.
* Conduct quality audits to ensure all work has been completed and quality meets expectations.
* Audits and maintains inventories supplies and equipment.
* Investigates new and promotes improved equipment and methods.
* Reviews customer requests for service to ascertain cause for service request, type of malfunction, and address with manager.
* Implements organization policies and goals.
* Analyzes & facilitates budget requests to identify areas in which reductions can be made.
* Assist in the promotion of services performed to develop new markets, increase share of market, and obtain competitive position in industry.
* Inspects plant and evaluates use of space and facilities.
* Assists with plans, budgets, and schedules modifications including cost estimates bid sheets and contracts.
* Ensures that site meets budget goals on a sustaining basis.
* Assist in the development of long-range plans, conceptual designs, and capital outlay requirements for program/process improvements.
* Coordinates program specifications, requirements for proposals and contracts, and associated documents.
* Compiles data for preparing estimates.
* Maintain and report on financial part of business, such as, labor hours, overhead, supplies, expenses, billing, forecasting and any changes to these areas.
* Maintain a safe work environment for self and employees.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, such as, FLSA, OSHA, ADA, etc.
* Directs supervisory management engaged in support of facilities programs.
* Acts as liaison between company, customers, clients, employees, and subcontractors.
* Maintains contract and contractor status databases.
* Reviews all correspondence concerning contractors and responds as appropriate.
* Establishes and maintains contact with contractors to ensure the smooth working of the contract process.
* Conduct and attend meetings to communicate top down, and bottom up on a consistent real time basis, with customers, clients, and employees.
* Assist with human resource concerns and issues.
* Some travel is required for this position.

**Qualification**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to perform this job safely. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

**Education and/ or Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or a related field from a four-year college or university with 2 – 5 years of experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**

May be required to have a valid driver’s license.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

Bilingual a plus

Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Customer service, problem solving, time management, project management, planning, excellent communication, presentation, interviewing, coaching and training skills.

Knowledge of Microsoft Office and Computer Skills.

Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community.

Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, customers, employees, and public.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

Carries out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, planning, assigning, and directing work; approving and managing time for direct reports; performance evaluations; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems. Ensure employees are properly trained on tasks and safety requirements.

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit and talk or listen. The employee must be able to lift and/or move up to 35 pounds.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job.

Salary: $90K annually.

Position will oversee multiple programs including Pest Control, and events.

  

Schedule is Monday- Friday (8 am to 5 pm) Flexibility preferred.

**Benefits:**
=============

SBM offers comprehensive benefit packages. For information about SBM's benefits, please visit SBM's website at:

www.sbmmanagement.com/careers Careers – SBM

***SBM Management Services, LP and its affiliates are proud to be equal opportunity workplaces. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, sex, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or other legally protected status.***

new_jobs.description:
Residential Design Project Manager – Mandarin-SpeakingAbout Team Metric

Team Metric is a vertically integrated residential design, development, and construction company serving the San Francisco Bay Area. We specialize in single-family residential projects, including new custom homes, major additions and remodels, ADUs, and other residential development projects.

Our projects are managed by an integrated team that includes architectural design, drafting and production, interior design, landscape design, construction management, and outside professional consultants such as structural engineers, civil engineers, surveyors, Title 24 consultants, and other specialists.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and highly organized **Residential Design Project Manager** to manage residential projects through the design, entitlement, permitting, and approval process.

This is **not primarily a drafting or modeling position**. Our team includes dedicated designers and production staff who prepare schematic designs, 3D models, construction drawings, and permit packages.

The Design Project Manager is the person who **owns and coordinates the entire design and permitting process**.

You will work closely with clients, internal designers and drafting teams, outside consultants, City Planning and Building Departments, plan checkers, Public Works departments, utility companies, and our construction team to move each project efficiently from initial design through permit issuance.

The ideal candidate has previously worked on residential design projects and understands how all parts of a project come together. You should be comfortable reviewing architectural drawings, understanding zoning and building requirements, coordinating consultants, responding to plan-check comments, communicating with clients and city staff, and managing multiple projects and deadlines at the same time.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage residential projects from initial due diligence and schematic design through Planning and Building permit approval.
* Develop and maintain the overall design and permitting schedule for each project.
* Identify all required approvals, consultants, drawings, reports, applications, and permits early in the project to prevent delays later in the process.
* Research zoning regulations, development standards, design guidelines, building requirements, and jurisdiction-specific permitting procedures.
* Coordinate with internal schematic designers, architectural production/drafting teams, interior designers, landscape designers, and construction staff.
* Coordinate outside consultants including structural engineers, civil engineers, surveyors, Title 24 consultants, arborists, geotechnical engineers, and other professionals as required.
* Review architectural and consultant drawings for completeness, consistency, coordination, and compliance before submission.
* Prepare and coordinate Planning, Building, Public Works, demolition, encroachment, utility, and other permit submissions as required by each jurisdiction.
* Communicate directly with planners, plan checkers, building officials, Public Works staff, utility representatives, and other agencies.
* Track permit reviews, comments, corrections, resubmittals, approvals, and outstanding items.
* Coordinate responses to Planning and Building Department comments and make sure all responsible team members complete their portions on schedule.
* Communicate project status, design decisions, permitting issues, and required actions clearly to clients and internal team members.
* Manage multiple active residential projects simultaneously and maintain clear priorities, deadlines, and follow-up items.
* Proactively identify potential schedule, permitting, design, or coordination problems before they delay the project.
* Maintain organized project documentation, correspondence, permit records, consultant information, and approval history.
* Support the transition from the design/permitting phase into construction once permits are issued.

Qualifications

* **3+ years of relevant professional experience** in residential architecture, design, permitting, construction, engineering, planning, or a closely related field.
* Experience working on residential projects through Planning and/or Building permit approval.
* Strong understanding of architectural drawings and the residential design and construction process.
* Ability to read, review, and mark up architectural and consultant drawings.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, consultants, and stakeholders without losing track of important details.
* Strong research and problem-solving skills, particularly when working with zoning codes, design standards, permitting requirements, and unfamiliar jurisdictional requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable communicating professionally with clients, architects, engineers, city staff, plan checkers, contractors, and other project participants.
* **Professional working proficiency in spoken Mandarin Chinese is required** because this position works directly with Mandarin-speaking members of our design and production team.
* Professional working proficiency in English is required for communication with clients, consultants, contractors, and local jurisdictions.

Preferred Background

Candidates may come from a variety of professional backgrounds. Relevant backgrounds may include:

* Architecture or Architectural Design
* Residential Design
* Civil or Structural Engineering
* Construction Management
* Interior Architecture or Interior Design
* Urban Planning
* Landscape Architecture or Landscape Design
* Residential Development
* Design-Build firms

A California Architect license is **not required**.

Experience with Bay Area residential permitting and familiarity with local jurisdictions is strongly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

**Overview:**

Are you passionate about blending business consulting with advanced analytics? We’re seeking a Senior Value Engineer to join our FinOps & Spend Analytics team at Snowflake. You’ll collaborate with account teams and engage directly with customers to optimize their use of Snowflake’s cloud platform.

The ideal candidate brings:

* **Analytical Skills**: Proficiency in Excel, SQL, and Python to deliver actionable insights.
* **Technical Architecture Understanding**: Familiarity with cloud-based systems, ideally Snowflake, to understand and communicate technical aspects in addition to financial optimizations.
* **Consulting or Sales Experience**: Background in financial planning and analysis (FP&A), business/IT consulting, or consultative sales to engage and drive customer value.

Experience in FP&A and business consulting paired with strong analytical and technical skills, will be key to success in this role.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Consultative Engagements**: Partner with account teams and customers to frame and address complex business challenges through data-driven insights, focusing on cost optimization, performance enhancement, and ROI maximization.
* **Advanced Data Analysis:** Analyze customer consumption data on Snowflake to provide actionable insights that attribute, control, and optimize spend across various business units, workloads, and use cases.
* **Cloud Economics & FinOps**: Develop and refine cloud unit economics models, define KPIs, and support cost, usage, and performance benchmarks tailored to specific customer needs.
* **Strategic ROI Modeling:** Build and maintain sophisticated ROI and economic models to support customer budgeting, forecasting, and the rollout of new Snowflake features.
* **Data Storytelling:** Translate complex data insights into compelling narratives that influence strategic decisions, catering to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications:**

* **Education**: A Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Computer Science, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline. Advanced degrees or certifications in analytics or business management (e.g., MBA) are advantageous.
* **Work Experience:** 6-10 years of relevant working experience, including 4+ years focused in data analytics, financial planning and analysis (FP&A), business consulting, or cloud data warehousing.
* **Business Consulting/FP&A Expertise**: A strong background in business consulting or FP&A, with a proven ability to solve complex business problems using data and analytics.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Advanced skills in SQL and Excel for data analysis and reporting – familiarity with Python and Snowflake or other cloud-based data platforms will be an advantage.
* **Cloud Technology Acumen**: A solid understanding of cloud technology architectures, particularly in data warehousing, and experience in cloud economics or FinOps will be a plus.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

* This role is eligible to participate in Snowflake's commission plan and it is common for employees in this role to receive total on-target earnings of $222,700 - $292,320. The estimated base salary for this role is $167,025 - $219,240.
* Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

new_jobs.title: Marketing Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

**Working at Abbott**

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
* An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.
* Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

Lingo is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented **Marketing Project Manager** to serve as the central hub for creative operations, content approvals, and marketing workflow management. This role will be responsible for managing the end-to-end lifecycle of marketing projects, from intake through final release, while ensuring compliance with quality management, promotional review, and regulatory processes.

The ideal candidate combines strong marketing project management experience with an understanding of content approval workflows in regulated industries. This individual will partner closely with Product Marketing, CRM, Performance Marketing, Creative, Retail Marketing, HCP, Partnerships. Brand, Social, Regulatory Affairs, Medical/Legal/Regulatory (MLR), and external stakeholders to ensure projects move efficiently through review, approval, production, and distribution.

Success requires strong communication skills, exceptional attention to detail, comfort working with marketing technologies and workflow systems, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

**What You’ll Work On**

**Marketing Project & Workflow Management**

* Own and manage the creative intake process for marketing initiatives across digital, CRM, performance marketing, retail, social, ecommerce, and product marketing channels.
* Champion content approval workflows supporting Lingo's marketing initiatives.
* Facilitate project kickoffs and ensure clear project requirements, timelines, dependencies, and deliverables are documented.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to gather, track, and resolve feedback efficiently.
* Monitor project schedules, milestones, risks, and priorities to ensure deadlines are met.
* Maintain visibility of project status and communicate updates to stakeholders.

**Quality Management & Content Approval**

* Manage marketing asset workflows within Wrike and Veeva and/or comparable Quality Management Systems.
* Coordinate review and approval processes involving Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Marketing stakeholders.
* Review promotional materials and ensure document accuracy, version control, and content fidelity.
* Upload, organize, and maintain approved marketing content within quality management systems.
* Ensure compliance with internal approval processes, documentation standards, and content governance requirements.
* Support audit readiness through accurate documentation and content traceability.

new_jobs.title: Senior Officer, Patient Access
new_jobs.description:
**Background**

The California Institute for Regenerative Medicine (CIRM) is a state agency created by California voters to accelerate stem cell and gene therapies for people with unmet medical needs. Since 2004, Californians have entrusted CIRM with $8.5 billion to accelerate promising discoveries through clinical trials, train a regenerative medicine workforce, strengthen the state’s biotechnology economy, and expand access to transformative treatments. Today, CIRM is pioneering new models of therapy development and accelerating medical breakthroughs that change lives — in California and around the world. For more information, visit www.cirm.ca.gov.

  

**General Statement**

The Patient Access (PA) Team collaborates across CIRM’s core programs to foster innovative care delivery models and enhance the accessibility of regenerative medicine therapies. The PA Team’s operational goal is to enhance access to clinical trials and approved therapies for all Californians by coordinating clinical infrastructure networks, by supporting market access & patient access strategic planning for CIRM-funded therapies, and by advancing access and affordability research. Additionally, the PA Team serves as a bridge to policymakers and payers, coordinating execution of CIRM’s Access & Affordability strategy as well as coordinating CIRM’s Accessibility and Affordability Working Group (AAWG) as outlined in Proposition 14.

  

The Senior Officer, Patient Access will fill a critical role within the PA team by supporting CIRM-funded preclinical and clinical stage projects on stage-appropriate patient access and market access strategic planning activities. The role will develop and update patient access planning requirements for CIRM preclinical and clinical project funding programs, will be responsible for reviewing the progress of stage-appropriate planning activities, and will identify trends and opportunities for supporting enhanced patient access to CIRM-funded therapies. This role requires independent judgment, cross-functional influence, and deep subject matter expertise in development and execution of patient access and market access strategies for cell and gene therapies.

**Implement Patient Access Planning Requirements**

* Develop, implement, and maintain stage-appropriate patient access and market access planning requirements for CIRM-funded preclinical and clinical programs.
* Serve as a primary point of contact and subject matter resource for CIRM applicants and awardees navigating patient access planning requirements.
* Identify, recruit, and onboard leading experts to serve as reviewers for evaluating patient access planning components of CIRM grant applications and as external advisors for assess patient access planning progress across CIRM awards.

  

**Support Patient Access Planning for CIRM-Funded Therapies**

* Provide guidance to prospective applicants and current awardees on stage-appropriate patient access planning requirements, application expectations, and budget justification for access planning activities.
* Identify and curate resources, consultants, service providers, and best practices to support CIRM awardees in executing patient access and market access planning activities.
* Work closely with the Programs Teams to monitor and track progress of patient access, market access, and commercialization planning activities across CIRM's preclinical and clinical portfolio.
* Review and adjudicate patient access planning milestone reports and support Programs Teams’ approval of operational milestones and associated funding disbursements for preclinical and clinical stage awards.
* Collaborate with the Associate Director of Patient Access to facilitate use of CIRM's clinical infrastructure for enabling patient access to CIRM-funded therapies.
* Participate in Late-Stage Portfolio Management to track and support pre-commercialization and post-approval patient access activities for CIRM-funded therapies.

  

**Conduct Portfolio-Level Analysis & Contribute to CIRM Strategy Execution**

* Collate and analyze trends in patient access, market access, and commercialization strategies across CIRM's active portfolio.
* Track post-approval real world patient access to CIRM-funded therapies and benchmark against industry landscape
* Report portfolio findings and insights to the CIRM Access & Affordability Working Group (AAWG) to inform CIRM's overall Access & Affordability strategy.
* Collaborate with Patient Access Team leadership and the AAWG to identify gaps and additional resources needed to support patient access to CIRM-funded therapies.

* Support the Patient Access Team and AAWG in evaluating and advancing innovative financial and reimbursement models that promote affordability and sustainability of CIRM-funded therapies.

  

**Establish Thought Leadership**

* Routinely engage with payers, providers, patient advocates, health economists and therapy developers to maintain current knowledge and thought leadership on patient access and market access strategies.
* Monitor and analyze trends in payer coverage, reimbursement policy, and healthcare delivery relevant to cell and gene therapies to maintain current awareness and inform CIRM strategy and awardee support.
* Represent CIRM in scientific, industry, regulatory and policy forums.

  

**Required Qualifications (Experience and Education)**

* Bachelor’s degree in public health, Public Policy, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, Health Economics, Life Sciences, or a related field relevant to development and commercial delivery of biologic drug products.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with direct involvement in development or executing strategies across pre-commercialization planning, launch planning, market access, patient access, payer strategy, HEOR, government affairs or similar commercial roles.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (Master’s, PhD, PharmD

new_jobs.title: UAS Operations Specialist - Ground Support
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
------------------

As a **UAS Operations Ground Support Specialist**, you'll join Flight Operations in a **qualified Commercial Ground Support position** supporting safe, **compliant UAS delivery operations under Part 135**. All hires complete **required training and qualification under the company's FAA-approved training program** before independently performing assigned duties.

You'll work alongside Remote Pilots in Command (RPICs), Flight Operations leadership, and Maintenance to **support aircraft readiness, safe ground operations, and mission execution** through disciplined procedures and clear communication.

You'll also work cross-functionally with Flight Test, Engineering, and other teams to **support Part 107 testing**, developmental operations, and system validation within applicable authorizations and established safety controls.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Serve as **qualified Commercial Ground Support** within Flight Operations **for Part 135 UAS operations** once trained, qualified, and authorized.
* **Complete training delivered by a qualified Ground Instructor under the company's FAA-approved training program** and required competency evaluations. Initial-cadre members complete the applicable **FAA qualification and evaluation process.**
* Maintain **required qualifications, recurrent training,** proficiency, and standardization requirements.
* **Support aircraft preparation**, staging, payload handling, battery management, equipment setup, launch and recovery, and aircraft turnaround **within assigned responsibilities.**
* **Verify** aircraft, payload, equipment, and **operating-area readiness in accordance with assigned Ground Support procedures and checklists.**
* **Apply applicable Part 135 requirements, company manuals, SOPs, checklists, Operations Specifications, exemptions, waivers, and operating limitations** relevant to assigned duties.
* **Coordinate with the RPIC** and operational personnel throughout missions, **maintaining situational awareness and timely communication** of ground conditions and aircraft readiness.
* **Pause unsafe ground activities and promptly escalate concerns through established channels**. Flight command authority remains with the RPIC.
* **Identify and report hazards**, **aircraft discrepancies, equipment damage, and procedural deviations** through established safety and maintenance channels.
* Maintain accurate training, qualification, operational, and equipment **records required for assigned activities.**
* **Support abnormal and emergency operations within defined Ground Support responsibilities,** including required drills and emergency procedure training.
* **Work cross-functionally with Flight Test, Engineering, and other teams to support Part 107 testing**, developmental operations, demonstrations, and validation within assigned duties and applicable authorizations.
* **Provide structured operational feedback** and contribute to improvements in ground procedures, SOPs, checklists, equipment, and training materials.
* When qualified and designated, qualify additional Ground Support crew members under the **FAA-approved training program**. **Training duties require separate qualification and designation as a Ground Instructor**.
* **Work outdoors with extended standing**, equipment handling, and **varying weather conditions while following company safety practices and operating limits**.
* **Maintain schedule flexibility** for commercial operations, training, and testing, **including day, evening, and weekend assignments as required**.
* **Participate in the company's FAA/DOT drug and alcohol testing program** when assigned duties are covered under 14 CFR Part 120, **including pre-employment drug testing and applicable ongoing testing under 49 CFR Part 40**.

**You're Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Hold a qualified operational position** supporting commercial Part 135 UAS delivery.
* **Develop through an FAA-approved training program** with defined qualification and proficiency standards.
* **Work alongside pilots and Maintenance** to support aircraft readiness and safe mission execution.
* **Collaborate with technical teams during Part 107 flight testing** and system validation.
* **Be considered for additional qualification responsibilities** as your proficiency and program needs develop.
* Contribute directly to safe, standardized, and scalable drone delivery operations.

**We're Excited About You Because…**
------------------------------------

* **You Have Relevant Operational Experience:**  
  Experience in UAS, aviation ground operations, logistics, maintenance, or another safety-critical environment is preferred.
* **You Meet and Maintain Qualification Standards:**  
  You hold a valid Part 107 certificate and you can complete required training, competency evaluations, recurrent training, and standardization requirements and maintain eligibility for assigned duties.
* **You're Safety-Minded and Procedurally Disciplined:**  
  You consistently follow manuals, SOPs, checklists, and operating limitations, recognize hazards, and pause or escalate activities when conditions are unsafe.
* **You're Hands-On and Detail-Oriented:**  
  You're comfortable handling aircraft, batteries, payloads, and support equipment, and can identify incorrect configurations, discrepancies, and abnormal conditions.
* **You Communicate and Collaborate Clearly:**  
  You provide timely, accurate operational callouts and work effectively with pilots, Maintenance, Flight Test, and cross-functional teams within defined responsibilities.
* **You Document with Discipline:**  
  You maintain accurate training, qualification, operational, and equipment records and report observations clearly to support traceability, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* **You're Prepared for Additional Responsibility:**  
  Additional qualification or G

new_jobs.description:
Join the transformative team at City of Hope, where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. City of Hope’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. our dedicated and compassionate employees are driven by a common mission: To deliver the cures of tomorrow to the people who need them today.

**\*\* This is a Fully Remote Opportunity within the United States\*\***

**Position Summary:**

The Senior Regulatory Quality Program Manager is responsible for ensuring the organization complies with regulatory requirements through quality performance measurement, data integrity, and EHR-enabled reporting programs. This position will support enterprise regulatory quality programs, including development and implementation of EHR-aligned workflows, data capture processes, and performance measurement frameworks. Responsible for staying up to date with federal and state regulatory requirements and translating requirements into quality measure specifications, reporting logic, and data capture workflows within the EHR and analytics platforms. This position provides the connection between healthcare clinical federal and state regulatory programs, EHR systems, data structures, and regulatory quality performance outcomes.

The Senior Regulatory Quality Program Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating enterprise-level programs that support regulatory compliance, quality performance reporting, regulatory measurement, and EHR-enabled compliance programs across City of Hope. This role operates in close partnership with executive leadership to support enterprise-wide regulatory strategy, program execution, and performance oversight.

**As a successful candidate, you will:**

**Regulatory Quality Metrics, Data, and Program Execution:**

Serves as a subject matter expert in healthcare regulatory programs, including CMS quality reporting and interoperability requirements, with a primary focus on quality performance measurement and data integrity. Monitors evolving federal and state regulatory requirements and translates these into regulatory measure specifications, reporting logic, and EHR-aligned data capture workflows.

Coordinates the planning, implementation, and execution of regulatory programs (e.g., MIPS, eCQMs, registry-based submissions), ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant reporting. new_jobs.description:
The Illinois Regional Care Coordination Agency (RCCA) administers and manages sub-awards related to opioid settlement funds, supports related public-facing websites, and helps coordinate regional opioid response efforts in Illinois. The RCCA supports equitable implementation of state resources for communities affected by the opioid crisis.

The Senior Program Manager I will lead an assigned portfolio of subrecipient programs. This role is accountable for performance monitoring, deliverable accountability, compliance, complex relationship management, and sound program decisions. The position requires the ability to coordinate work across teams through influence rather than supervisory authority.

The role requires independent judgment. The ideal candidate can interpret governing authorities, assess risk, monitor performance and fiscal compliance, resolve issues within delegated authority, and escalate matters that exceed that authority. They also bring experience with procurement, stakeholder coordination, competing priorities, and program monitoring.

**About the Position**  
This is a remote position based in Illinois. The position requires travel throughout the state and to AHP's Chicago Office for meetings and training.

The **Senior Program Manager I** for will demonstrate knowledge, skills and abilities including, but not limited to the following:

**Knowledge**

**Grant Compliance and Funding Administration:**

* Working knowledge of federal grants management under 2 CFR Part 200 and Illinois grants administration under GATA, including the ability to apply requirements in practical situations.
* Working knowledge of the grant funding structures, including the roles and responsibilities of awarding agencies, pass-through entities, and subrecipients.
* Knowledge of contracting processes and statement of work construction, including key performance indicators, scope, and schedule.
* Working knowledge of nonprofit fiscal operations, documentation requirements, and reimbursement processes sufficient to review subrecipient invoices.

**Substance Use Policy and Program Implementation:**

* High-level knowledge of the Illinois substance use policy and service systems, including opioid settlement funded initiatives, prevention, treatment, recovery supports, and harm reduction.
* Intermediate knowledge of implementation science and its application to subrecipient technical assistance, sufficient to select interventions that address cause rather than symptom.

**Training and Technical Assistance:**

* Firsthand understanding of adult learning principles sufficient to design and deliver effective training and technical assistance at a variety of audiences.

### **Skills**

**Regulatory Analysis and Monitoring:**

* Interpret grant and federal requirements and analyze their application to complex or novel program situations, including circumstances not explicitly addressed in existing rules or guidance, and to elevate such matters to leadership for review and approval before taking action.
* Create monitoring plans that match subrecipient’s level of risk instead of using the same checklist for every organization.
* Review performance and spending data across multiple subrecipients to distinguish one-time issues, trends and needed follow-up from broader program problems.
* Write clear findings, recommended determinations, and escalation summaries that explain the issue, evidence, analysis, and recommended next step.

**Communication and Facilitation:**

* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with colleagues and partners to address complex issues and achieve meaningful outcomes.
* Communicate clearly with subrecipients, fiscal staff, subject matter experts, and RCCA leadership.
* Independently plan meeting agendas and prepare supporting materials.
* Effectively facilitate productive meetings that keep participants focused on outcomes.
* Prepare high-quality meeting minutes and follow-up documentation in a timely manner.
* Address compliance concerns and difficult or sensitive issues in a professional, respectful, and solution-oriented manner.

Join the team as Twilio’s next Sr. Program Manager, Talent Development

This position is needed to build and lead the live learning experiences that shape how Twilions grow, lead, and work together. You will design and facilitate Twilio's development programs, design and lead leadership team offsites, and serve as an internal coach to leaders and emerging talent around the globe.

  

Reporting to the Senior Director of Talent Development, you will spend most of your time in the room, virtual or in person, with Twilions: designing programs, facilitating sessions, guiding leadership teams through high-stakes offsites, and coaching leaders through pivotal growth moments. The ideal candidate is an expert facilitator and credentialed coach who designs with rigor, reads a room in real time, and turns every session into measurable behavior change.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* Design and build facilitated development programs end to end, from needs assessment and learning objectives through facilitator guides, participant materials, and experiential activities, for leaders, managers, and individual contributors globally.
* Facilitate Twilio's development programs in person, virtually, and in hybrid formats, delivering engaging, inclusive sessions that build skills and shift behavior across a global, remote-first workforce.
* Design and facilitate leadership team offsites and team effectiveness sessions, partnering with senior leaders to define outcomes, build agendas, guide strategic conversations, and drive clear commitments and follow-through.
* Serve as an internal coach to leaders and high-potential talent, delivering one-on-one and team coaching engagements and embedding coaching into development programs to reinforce learning.
* Build internal facilitation capability by developing and certifying a bench of facilitators, and set the design and delivery standards for Talent Development programs.
* Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to diagnose capability gaps and determine whether training, coaching, or a facilitated team intervention is the right solution.
* Measure the impact of programs, offsites, and coaching through participant feedback, behavior change, and business outcomes, and use the data to continuously iterate.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  

* **Required:**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Adult Learning, Education, or a related field preferred.
* 7-10 years in talent development, with 7+ years designing and facilitating leadership, manager, and professional development programs.
* Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating executive and leadership team offsites, including strategic planning, team alignment, and team effectiveness sessions.
* Expert facilitation skills across in-person, virtual, and hybrid formats, with the ability to engage diverse global audiences and navigate challenging group dynamics in real time.
* Strong instructional design skills grounded in adult learning principles, including building facilitator guides and programs that scale through train-the-trainer models.
* Executive presence with the ability to build trust quickly, deliver candid feedback, and maintain strict confidentiality with senior leaders.
* Experience using learning and coaching data, including feedback, behavior change, and business metrics, to demonstrate impact and drive program decisions.
* Willingness to travel for in-person programs and offsites (approx. 25%).

**Desired:**

* Certification in assessment tools such as Hogan, DiSC, MBTI, or 360-degree feedback instruments.
* Experience building an internal coaching program or a facilitator certification pathway.
* Experience applying AI tools to accelerate program design, personalize learning, or extend the reach of coaching.
* Ability to effectively prioritize a full facilitation and coaching calendar in a fast-paced, ever-changing culture.

  

**Location**

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

  

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you will travel regularly to facilitate in-person programs and leadership offsites (approx. 25%).

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

new_jobs.title: EverHealth - Process Improvement Manager (Remote, US)
new_jobs.description:
**EverHealth Process Improvement Manager**

EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications.

EverHealth is hiring a Process Improvement Manager to join a team rebuilding how work gets done across our healthcare software brands, including DrChrono, CollaborateMD, Updox, and eProvider Solutions. You will embed with a business function, in areas like go-to-market, customer success, customer experience, or operations, establish what the current process actually is, measure it, and redesign it.

  
  

Most of the functions we work with have processes that are undocumented, inconsistently followed, or built around constraints that no longer exist. Automating those as they stand would only make the problem run faster. Your job is to find the real constraint, fix the process, and hand a clean design to the engineers who build on top of it.

  
  

It suits someone who has run operational improvement work end to end, is comfortable sitting with a team and watching them work rather than relying on a process document, and can defend a redesign with evidence in front of a function leader.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

**Map the Current State**

* Reconstruct how a function works today through interviews, shadowing, and system data, at a level of detail the team recognizes as accurate.

* Separate elapsed time from touch time so the difference between work and waiting is visible, not assumed.

* Document the handoffs, queues, decision points, and exceptions that the official process does not describe.
  

  

**Measure and Baseline**

* Pull real duration, volume, and rework data from the systems a function runs on, rather than relying on self-reported estimates.

* Establish a defensible baseline for every engagement before any change is made, so improvement can be attributed rather than claimed.

* Define the operating metrics a function will run on after the engagement ends, and the definition behind each number.
  

  

**Redesign the Process**

* Design the future state from the constraint outward: flow, queue discipline, sequencing, ownership, and the gates that hold quality.

* Decide what should be eliminated, what should be standardized, and only then what should be automated.

* Pressure-test a redesign against real cases and edge cases before it is rolled out, not after.
  

  

**Drive Adoption and Change**

* Work directly with function leaders and frontline teams so a redesign is adopted rather than announced.

* Build the training, standard work, and manager routines that keep a new process in place once the team moves on.

* Track whether a change held after handoff, and go back in when it did not.
  

  

**Partner Across the Business**

* Partner with our engineers so the build starts from a corrected process, and flag when a proposed build would automate a problem instead of solving it.

* Work with Finance to agree on how savings and capacity are defined and counted before results are reported.

* Build a repeatable method across engagements so the fifth function moves faster than the first.
  

  

**Skills and Experience Needed for Success in This Role**

* 5+ years in process improvement, operational excellence, business process consulting, or a hands-on operations leadership role with responsibility for redesigning how work is done.

* Demonstrated experience mapping a complex, multi-team process end to end and delivering a measured improvement, with numbers you can speak to.

* Strong quantitative skills. You can pull, clean, and interrogate operational data yourself in a spreadsheet or BI tool without waiting on an analyst.

* Skilled interviewer and observer who can get past what people say the process is to what it actually is.

* Working knowledge of flow and queue concepts, cycle time, work in progress, and constraint analysis, and the judgment to know which one applies.

* Credible with both frontline teams and executives, and able to hold a position when a redesign is unpopular.

* Clear, plain writer. Your maps, findings, and recommendations need to stand on their own after you leave the room.

* Comfortable with ambiguity and with being the first person to look closely at a function nobody has examined before.
  

  

**Preferred Experience**

* Healthcare technology, SaaS, or another regulated environment.

* Formal training in Lean, Six Sigma, or an equivalent improvement method, applied in practice rather than held as a certificate.

* Experience in implementation, onboarding, revenue cycle, support, or another high-volume operational function.

* Familiarity with CRM and project or work management systems, and with the data they produce.

* Experience working alongside a technical team on automation or AI projects.

* Change management experience where a redesign had to survive a leadership transition or a reorganization.
  

  

**Where:** The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. **This role can be based anywhere in the United States.** Candidates based in the Chicago area will work hybrid, meeting with the team in person 1–2 days per week. Candidates elsewhere in the U.S. will work remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this posi

new_jobs.title: GTM Operations Analyst – Analytics & Automation
new_jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

As part of the Global Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations team, this hands-on role delivers commercial analysis, reporting, and automation across the commercial organization.

Working alongside GTM Operations colleagues, business leaders, and technical specialists, the Analyst develops reliable insights and practical solutions that improve decision-making and reduce manual work. This role takes ownership of agreed initiatives while building on existing capabilities and supporting reuse across regions.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities**

* Partner with commercial stakeholders and GTM Operations colleagues to understand business needs and deliver agreed analytics and automation initiatives.
* Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models supporting planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and commercial execution.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating analysis into clear insights and recommendations.
* Develop workflow automations and AI-assisted solutions, working with technical specialists on complex requirements and integrations.
* Validate reporting and workflow outputs, document business logic, and support testing, adoption, and ongoing maintenance.
* Partner with Finance, Data & Analytics, IT, and regional operations to maintain consistent metric definitions and resolve data discrepancies.
* Share reusable solutions across regions, measure improvements in efficiency and business use, and manage assigned priorities independently.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum eight (8) years of experience in enterprise B2B software-as-a-service (SaaS) GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, or commercial analytics.
* Relevant experience in enterprise B2B software-as-a-service (SaaS) GTM Operations, Revenue Operations, or commercial analytics.
* Strong understanding of pipeline, forecasting, recurring revenue, and commercial processes.
* Hands-on business intelligence (BI) and data modeling skills, including experience building dashboards, analyzing data, and validating results.
* Practical experience using workflow automation and AI tools to improve business processes.
* A track record of delivering reliable analytical or automation solutions that achieve sustained business use.
* Ability to translate business questions into practical solutions, troubleshoot independently, and collaborate with technical specialists.
* Strong prioritization, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Salesforce reporting and Power BI.
* Familiarity with SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, APIs, Agentforce, or Copilot Studio.
Experience delivering reusable capabilities across regions with globally distributed teams.  

  

**COMMENTS:**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.

**Vertex Values: Together We Win**
==================================

We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.

**Play to Win or We Don't Play** — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.

  

**Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core** — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.

  

**Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility** — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.

  

**Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset** — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.

  

**Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency** — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

**Pay Transparency Statement:**

US Base Salary Range: $99,500.00 - $129,400.00

Base pay offered to new hires may vary based upon factors including relevant industry and job-related skills and experience, geographic location, and business needs.\* The range displayed does not encompass the full potential of the role, which allows for further growth and career progression.

In addition, as a part of our total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Vertex Bonus Plan (VOB), a role-specific sales commission/bonus, and/or equity grants.

Learn more about Life at Vertex and connect with your recruiter for more details regarding Vertex's compensation and benefit programs.

* *In no case will your pay fall below applicable local minimum wage requirements*.

new_jobs.title: Learning & Development Graphic Designer
new_jobs.description:
**Save lives, from the workplace to anyplace.**  
  
The National Safety Council is America’s leading nonprofit safety advocate. We focus on eliminating the leading causes of preventable injuries and deaths. Through leadership, research, education, and advocacy, NSC focuses on areas where most unintentional injuries and deaths occur.
  
  
We are currently looking for a **Learning & Development Graphic Designer** to join us in our mission to save lives and prevent injuries.
  
  
**Position Highlights:**

The Learning & Development Graphic Designer is responsible for developing visually compelling, instructionally aligned designs that support high-quality learning experiences across multiple training modalities. This role plays a key part in establishing and maintaining a consistent visual identity for all NSC training products, including digital learning, instructor-led materials, print publications, and other learner-facing assets.

The ideal candidate brings strong visual design expertise, experience with eLearning environments, and the ability to translate complex concepts into clear, engaging graphics that enhance the learner experience.

**What You’ll Do:**

**Design for Multiple Learning Modalities:**

* Produce high-quality visual assets for eLearning modules, instructor-led training, microlearning, video, and blended learning experiences using Articulate 360.
* Create professional layouts and graphics for print deliverables such as participant guides, job aids, infographics, workbooks, and other training publications.
* Experience in preparing files for print, determining print specifications and conducting press checks.
* Transform complex information into learner-friendly, accessible visual formats.

**Brand Consistency & Standards**

* Ensure consistency in the look and feel of all NSC training products across digital and print mediums.
* Develop and maintain visual standards, style guides, templates, and design systems specific to training content.
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure all training materials align with organizational branding and design best practices.

**Collaboration & Production Workflow**

* Work closely with instructional design, editorial, subject matter experts, and product development staff to support high-quality learning products.
* Provide creative expertise and recommendations on layout, graphics, and visual storytelling techniques.
* Organize and maintain design files, asset libraries, and version control processes to support efficient workflows.

**Tools & Technical Skills**

* Create digital assets using Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign), PowerPoint, and related design platforms.
* Develop graphics optimized for use in eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline or similar.
* Ensure all visual designs meet accessibility guidelines, including color contrast standards and alternative text considerations.

**We’re Looking for Someone with:**

* Minimum 3 years’ experience designing both eLearning and print products in a professional environment.
* Portfolio demonstrating multi‑modality learning design work.
* Strong understanding of storytelling through visual hierarchy, typography, layout, color theory, and branding.
* Experience with instructional design team collaboration.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a professional environment.
* Experience creating animations is a plus.
* Must be comfortable leading the development of new design systems.
* This is a remote position.
* Salary for this role is $80,000.

**Reasons You’ll Love it here:**  
NSC cares about the safety, health, and overall well-being of our employees. We offer competitive benefits, resources, and tools to promote a work-life balance that supports employees during all phases of life. We offer the following:

* At least 20 PTO days accrued 1st year and 11 paid holidays
* Flexible work arrangements
* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans
* Flex spending accounts for medical and dependent care
* 403(b) & Roth 403(b) with employer match up to 6%
* Reimbursable training
* Dress for your day

  
**Our hiring process is designed to give you the opportunity to shine at each step.**It starts with an assessment where you really showcase your drive for the role. From there, candidates selected for the first interview will discuss their skills and how they fit with our team. If you're a match, the second interview takes a deeper dive into your background and how you can contribute to our goals. After that, we'll make our final decision and let you know the outcome. This is our usual process, and we're excited to get to know you along the way!  
  
**NSC is a Recovery-Friendly Workplace.**  
We support individuals in or seeking recovery from substance use disorder by fostering a culture of respect, inclusion, and support. We provide access to confidential resources, reasonable accommodations, and a work environment that values your journey and contributions.  
  
**NSC is an equal opportunity employer.**
